etilenglicol estearato__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Etilenglicol Estearato","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El etilenglicol estearato es un agente opacificante y nacarante que se utiliza para dar aspecto perlado y mejorar la textura de productos para la piel y el cabello. Generalmente se considera de baja toxicidad y bien tolerado por la mayoría de los tipos de piel.","details":"Este ingrediente es un éster derivado de ácidos grasos que ayuda a espesar ligeramente las fórmulas y aportar una apariencia cremosa y brillante a geles y limpiadores. No está asociado a parabenos, ftalatos, sulfatos agresivos ni a liberadores de formaldehído, y no se considera un disruptor endocrino. En pieles muy sensibles o con tendencia a obstrucción de poros podría contribuir levemente a sensación pesada si se usa en altas concentraciones, pero el riesgo general es bajo.","category":"Agente opacificante y acondicionador"}

fragancia (uso diurno)__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Fragancia (uso Diurno)","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"La fragancia de uso diurno es una mezcla de compuestos aromáticos sintéticos y/o naturales utilizada para dar olor agradable al producto. Puede causar irritación o alergias en pieles sensibles.","details":"Bajo el término general de fragancia se agrupan muchos ingredientes, incluidos potenciales alérgenos y sustancias que no siempre se especifican individualmente en la etiqueta. En pieles sensibles, con dermatitis, rosácea o tendencia al eczema, puede provocar enrojecimiento, picor o brotes de irritación, especialmente con el uso diario y exposición al sol. No se asocia de forma directa con alteraciones hormonales como los parabenos, pero su carácter poco transparente y su potencial sensibilizante hacen recomendable evitarla en rutinas para piel sensible o dañada.","category":"Fragancia / perfume"}

双-二乙氧基二甘醇环己烷1__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"双-二乙氧基二甘醇环己烷1","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Este ingrediente parece ser un derivado de poliglicol y ciclohexano usado probablemente como solvente o modificador de textura en productos cosméticos. No se dispone de información pública amplia y estandarizada sobre este nombre específico en bases de datos cosméticas habituales.","details":"Por su estructura aproximada, es probable que actúe como disolvente, humectante o acondicionador de la textura, ayudando a solubilizar otros ingredientes en fórmulas de cuidado de la piel o del cabello. No se asocia directamente con parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, fragancias, aceites minerales, siliconas, alcoholes secantes ni metales pesados. Sin embargo, debido a la falta de datos específicos bajo esta denominación, es recomendable precaución adicional en pieles muy sensibles o con antecedentes de alergias, y observar cualquier signo de irritación tras su uso.","category":"Solvente y modificador de textura (probable)"}

cocamidopropil betaína__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Cocamidopropil Betaína","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"La cocamidopropil betaína es un tensioactivo anfótero derivado del coco, utilizado como agente espumante y limpiador suave en productos de piel y cabello. Generalmente se considera de baja irritación, pero se ha asociado con casos de dermatitis de contacto en personas sensibles.","details":"Aunque suele ser más suave que los sulfatos fuertes como SLS o SLES, la cocamidopropil betaína puede contener impurezas (como amidoaminas y nitrosaminas) que en algunas personas desencadenan irritación o alergias cutáneas, especialmente en piel muy sensible o dañada. No está relacionada con disruptores hormonales, ftalatos, formaldehído ni metales pesados, por lo que su principal preocupación es el potencial irritante/alergénico más que una toxicidad sistémica. En la mayoría de usuarios es segura para el uso diario, pero quienes tengan antecedentes de dermatitis o cuero cabelludo muy reactivo podrían preferir evitarla o hacer una prueba de tolerancia.","category":"Tensioactivo y agente limpiador"}

betaina de mirístico (derivado de nuez m.analysis: {"name":"Betaina de Mirístico (derivado de Nuez Moscada)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La betaina de mirístico derivada de la nuez moscada es un tensioactivo anfótero suave usado como agente limpiador y espumante en productos para la piel y el cabello. Suele considerarse de baja irritación y adecuada para pieles sensibles en concentraciones cosméticas habituales.","details":"Este tipo de betaina se utiliza para mejorar la formación de espuma y la capacidad de limpieza sin resecar en exceso la piel, contribuyendo además a una sensación más suave y acondicionadora. No pertenece a los sulfatos agresivos (como SLS o SLES), no es un paraben ni un ftalato, y no se asocia con liberación de formaldehído. En personas con piel muy reactiva o con alergia específica a la nuez moscada pueden aparecer irritación o sensibilidad, pero estos casos son poco frecuentes.","category":"Tensioactivo suave / agente limpiador"}

estearato de etilenglicol__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Estearato de Etilenglicol","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El estearato de etilenglicol es un emoliente y agente opacificante utilizado en productos para el cuidado de la piel y el cabello para aportar textura cremosa y aspecto perlado. Generalmente se considera un ingrediente de baja irritación y baja toxicidad en concentraciones cosméticas habituales.","details":"Se usa principalmente como agente de consistencia, emulsionante secundario y para dar un acabado nacarado a limpiadores, champús y cremas. No pertenece a los parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído ni fragancias, y no se asocia con efectos disruptores hormonales conocidos. En pieles muy sensibles o con tendencia a obstrucción de poros, su naturaleza lipídica podría contribuir ligeramente a comedogenicidad si se combina con otros aceites oclusivos, aunque el riesgo suele ser bajo.","category":"Emoliente y agente opacificante"}

cocamidopropyl betaine (derivado de cera.analysis: {"name":"Cocamidopropyl Betaine (derivado de Cera de Ballena Sintética)","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Es un tensioactivo anfótero y agente acondicionador derivado de ácidos grasos, utilizado para aportar suavidad y espuma en productos de cuidado de la piel y el cabello. Generalmente se considera suave, pero puede causar irritación o alergias de contacto en algunas personas sensibles.","details":"Este ingrediente se emplea como agente limpiador y espumante suave en limpiadores faciales, champús y geles de baño, ayudando a reducir la irritación provocada por otros tensioactivos más agresivos. Aunque en la mayoría de los usuarios es bien tolerado, se han descrito casos de dermatitis de contacto, sobre todo cuando se combina con otros irritantes o en piel muy reactiva. No está asociado a parabenos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, metales pesados ni sulfatos tipo SLS/SLES, pero se recomienda precaución en personas con antecedentes de piel muy sensible o alergias a tensioactivos.","category":"Tensioactivo y acondicionador cutáneo/capilar"}

alcohol isopropílico__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Alcohol Isopropílico","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"El alcohol isopropílico es un alcohol secante que se usa como disolvente y agente desinfectante en productos para el cuidado de la piel. Puede resultar irritante y resecar la piel, especialmente en pieles sensibles o comprometidas.","details":"En cosmética, el alcohol isopropílico ayuda a disolver otros ingredientes y a que la fórmula se seque rápidamente sobre la piel o el cabello. Sin embargo, su uso frecuente o en altas concentraciones puede alterar la barrera cutánea, aumentar la deshidratación y favorecer irritación o enrojecimiento. Las personas con piel seca, sensible o con afecciones como dermatitis deben ser especialmente cautelosas con productos que lo contengan en proporciones elevadas.","category":"Alcohol desnaturalizante/solvente"}

proteína de seda de gusano__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Proteína de Seda de Gusano","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La proteína de seda de gusano se utiliza en cosmética por sus propiedades hidratantes, suavizantes y formadoras de película sobre la piel y el cabello. Suele ser bien tolerada y no está asociada a disruptores hormonales ni a los químicos agresivos más comunes.","details":"Esta proteína se obtiene de la seda producida por los gusanos de seda y actúa ayudando a retener la humedad y a mejorar la textura de la piel y el cabello. Generalmente tiene bajo potencial irritante, aunque en personas muy sensibles o con alergia a proteínas animales podría causar ligera irritación o reacción alérgica. No pertenece a las familias de parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, siliconas ni aceites minerales, por lo que se considera un ingrediente de bajo riesgo en formulaciones de cuidado personal.","category":"Proteína acondicionadora e hidratante"}

miristamidopropil betaína__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Miristamidopropil Betaína","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Es un tensioactivo anfótero suave derivado de ácidos grasos que se usa como agente limpiador y espumante en productos para el cuidado de la piel y el cabello. Suele considerarse bien tolerado por la mayoría de los tipos de piel.","details":"La miristamidopropil betaína ayuda a eliminar suciedad y grasa mientras reduce la irritación que pueden causar otros tensioactivos más agresivos, por lo que se usa con frecuencia en fórmulas suaves o para piel sensible. En concentraciones habituales de cosméticos presenta bajo potencial irritante, aunque en pieles muy reactivas puede causar enrojecimiento o picor si se combina con otros surfactantes fuertes. No es un paraben, ftalato, sulfato ni liberador de formaldehído, y no se asocia con efectos hormonales conocidos.","category":"Tensioactivo / agente limpiador suave"}

isopropanol__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Isopropanol","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"El isopropanol es un alcohol de cadena corta que se usa como disolvente y agente desinfectante en productos de cuidado personal. Puede resultar resecante e irritante para la piel, especialmente en concentraciones altas o en piel sensible.","details":"Este alcohol volátil se evapora rápidamente y ayuda a que las fórmulas se sequen más rápido, pero también puede alterar la barrera cutánea y aumentar la pérdida de agua transepidérmica cuando se usa con frecuencia. En pieles secas, sensibles o con afecciones como dermatitis o rosácea, puede provocar enrojecimiento, escozor e irritación. Su uso puntual en bajas concentraciones suele considerarse aceptable, pero no se recomienda en productos de uso continuo para pieles comprometidas.","category":"Alcohol desecante / disolvente"}

偏重亚硫酸钠__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"偏重亚硫酸钠","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"偏重亚硫酸钠是一种防腐剂和抗氧化剂，可防止产品氧化变色或变质。对一般人来说安全性尚可，但对敏感肌肤或哮喘、对亚硫酸盐过敏人群可能引起刺激或过敏反应。","details":"在护肤和护发产品中，偏重亚硫酸钠主要用于稳定配方、防止成分氧化并延长保质期。少数人，尤其是对亚硫酸盐敏感者，可能出现皮肤发红、瘙痒或刺激，吸入高浓度粉尘还可能诱发呼吸不适或哮喘症状。一般使用浓度较低时风险较可控，但敏感肌、过敏体质和哮喘人群建议谨慎使用或先小面积测试。","category":"防腐剂 / 抗氧化剂"}

异丙醇__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"异丙醇","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"异丙醇是一种常见溶剂和消毒用醇类，具有较强的挥发性和脱脂能力。护肤品中高浓度或频繁使用可能导致皮肤干燥、刺痛或屏障受损。","details":"在护肤和美发产品中，异丙醇常用于帮助溶解成分、加速干燥或具有一定的防腐作用。由于它属于较“干燥型”酒精，会溶解皮脂并削弱角质层屏障，对干性、敏感性或受损皮肤可能造成紧绷、脱屑或刺激。低浓度、偶尔使用一般风险较低，但敏感肌和屏障受损人群宜谨慎使用或避免高排位、长时间停留型产品中含有此成分。","category":"溶剂 / 干燥型酒精"}

乙二胺四乙酸二钠__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"乙二胺四乙酸二钠","riskLevel":"low","summary":"乙二胺四乙酸二钠是一种螯合剂，常用于护肤和护发品中帮助稳定配方、防止金属离子影响产品品质。一般被认为安全性较高，刺激性较低。","details":"它通过与水中或配方中的金属离子（如铁、铜等）结合，防止这些离子催化氧化反应，从而延缓产品变色、变味或失效。少数敏感肌人群在高浓度或长期接触下，可能出现轻微刺激或干燥感，但在常规化妆品使用剂量下风险较低。该成分本身不属于防腐剂、激素干扰物或致敏香精成分，主要作用是配方稳定。","category":"螯合剂 / 配方稳定剂"}

双二乙氧基二甘醇环己烷-14-二羧酸酯__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"双二乙氧基二甘醇环己烷-1,4-二羧酸酯","riskLevel":"low","summary":"这是一种合成酯类成分，常用于护肤品中作为柔润剂和成膜剂，帮助提升产品的延展性和肤感。一般认为刺激性较低，致敏风险不高。","details":"双二乙氧基二甘醇环己烷-1,4-二羧酸酯具有良好的润滑和增塑特性，可改善配方的使用触感，使皮肤感觉柔滑不黏腻。现有公开资料中未显示其与防腐剂释放甲醛、邻苯二甲酸酯、对羟基苯甲酸酯类（防腐剂）、硫酸盐表活或重金属等高风险类别直接相关。对大多数肤质来说安全性较好，但极度敏感或对酯类溶剂有特殊不耐受的人群仍应在小面积先行测试。","category":"合成酯类柔润剂/成膜剂"}

香精__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"香精","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"香精是多种香料成分的混合物，常用于赋予护肤品愉悦气味。它常见的风险是引起皮肤刺激或过敏，尤其对敏感肌人群。","details":"香精通常为多种天然及合成芳香化学物的统称，配方往往不完全公开，其中可能包含致敏香料或微量邻苯二甲酸酯等潜在有害物质。对敏感肌、痘痘肌、屏障受损或有鼻炎、哮喘、香料过敏史的人群，香精更容易引发刺痛、红斑、瘙痒甚至接触性皮炎。长期高频使用高香精产品可能增加敏感风险，因此建议敏感肌或婴幼儿护理尽量选择“无香精”或“低致敏香料”产品。","category":"香料与香精"}

二丁基羟基甲苯（bht）__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"二丁基羟基甲苯（BHT）","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"BHT 是一种合成抗氧化剂，常用于护肤和护发产品中防止油脂和配方氧化变质。一般浓度下对大多数人较为安全，但存在一定潜在刺激和争议性毒理风险。","details":"研究显示，BHT 在化妆品中通常用量较低，正常使用时系统性毒性风险较小，但部分人可能出现皮肤刺激或过敏反应。动物实验提示其可能与内分泌干扰、肝脏负担或致癌性相关，但这些多与高剂量、长期暴露有关，尚不足以直接等同于日常化妆品使用风险。由于属于有争议的合成抗氧化防腐成分，孕期、敏感肌或极度成分谨慎者可选择尽量减少接触。","category":"合成抗氧化剂 / 防腐辅助成分"}

水解蚕丝蛋白__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"水解蚕丝蛋白","riskLevel":"low","summary":"水解蚕丝蛋白是一种从蚕丝中提取并水解得到的小分子蛋白，常用于护肤和护发产品中以提升保湿和柔滑度。一般耐受性较好，过敏风险较低。","details":"水解蚕丝蛋白具有良好的成膜性和亲水性，可帮助皮肤和头发锁水，改善干燥、粗糙感，使触感更加柔软细腻。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或甲醛释放体，也与矿物油、硅油和重金属无直接关联。极少数对蛋白或蚕丝成分高度敏感的人可能出现刺激或过敏反应，通常通过敏感测试即可规避风险。","category":"保湿剂/护肤护发活性成分"}

硬脂酸乙二醇酯__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"硬脂酸乙二醇酯","riskLevel":"low","summary":"硬脂酸乙二醇酯是一种常见的乳化增稠剂和珠光剂，常用于洗面奶、洗发水、沐浴露等清洁类产品中。整体刺激性较低，一般被认为是安全性较好的成分。","details":"它主要用于改善产品的质地和外观，使产品呈现乳白或珠光效果，同时增加肤感的柔滑度。现有研究未显示其具有内分泌干扰、致癌或致畸等明显高风险特性，也不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐表活、邻苯二甲酸酯或甲醛释放体等高关注成分。少数极度敏感或屏障受损人群可能出现轻微刺激或不适，但在日常配方中属于较为温和、安全的功能性辅料。","category":"乳化剂 / 珠光剂 / 质地调理剂"}

fragrance (perfume)__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Fragrance (perfume)","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Fragrance is a mixture of aromatic compounds used to give products a pleasant scent but is a common source of skin irritation and allergic reactions. It can also include potential hormone-disrupting chemicals like some phthalates, though these are not always present or disclosed.","details":"Because 'fragrance' is a generic term, the exact chemicals are usually not listed, which makes it hard to know whether sensitizers, allergens, or phthalates are included. In skincare and haircare, fragrance is a leading cause of contact dermatitis, especially for people with sensitive or compromised skin. Fragrance-free or explicitly 'no added fragrance' products are often preferred for those prone to eczema, rosacea, or allergies.","category":"Fragrance and potential allergens"}

cocamidopropyl betaine__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Cocamidopropyl Betaine","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Cocamidopropyl betaine is a mild surfactant derived from coconut oil commonly used to create foam and improve cleansing. It is generally considered gentle, but some people can develop irritation or allergic contact dermatitis, often due to impurities from its manufacturing process.","details":"This ingredient helps water mix with oil and dirt so they can be rinsed away, and it is widely used in shampoos, face washes, and body cleansers as a less-harsh alternative to strong sulfates like SLS. Sensitivity issues are usually linked to residual by-products (such as amidoamine), and most users tolerate it well, especially in rinse-off products. Those with very reactive or eczema-prone skin may still wish to patch test products containing it.","category":"Surfactant / cleansing agent"}

bis-diethoxydiglycol cyclohexane-14-dica.analysis: {"name":"Bis-diethoxydiglycol Cyclohexane-1,4-dicarboxylate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Bis-diethoxydiglycol cyclohexane-1,4-dicarboxylate is a synthetic emollient and texture-enhancing ingredient used to improve skin feel and product spreadability. It is not associated with common problem groups like parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or formaldehyde releasers.","details":"Available safety data and its chemical class suggest a low irritation and sensitization potential for most users when used in typical cosmetic concentrations. It functions mainly to provide a smooth, velvety finish and can help dissolve or stabilize other oil-soluble ingredients. As with most synthetic emollients, individuals with very sensitive or reactive skin should patch test, but it is generally considered a low-risk component in skincare and haircare.","category":"Emollient / Texture enhancer"}

sodium acetylated hyaluronate__skincare_.analysis: {"name":"Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Sodium acetylated hyaluronate is a modified form of hyaluronic acid designed to improve moisture retention and skin barrier support. It is widely regarded as a gentle, beneficial hydrating ingredient.","details":"This ingredient combines the water-binding properties of hyaluronic acid with acetylation to increase affinity for skin and persistence on the surface, enhancing long-lasting hydration. It is not related to parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde-releasing preservatives, or drying alcohols, and has a very low rate of irritation or allergy. It is suitable for most skin types, including sensitive and dry skin, and is also common in haircare for scalp and hair moisture.","category":"Humectant / Hydrating agent"}

silk protein__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Silk Protein","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Silk protein (often present as hydrolyzed silk) is a naturally derived protein used to enhance moisture, smoothness, and film formation on skin and hair. It is generally well tolerated and considered low risk for most users.","details":"In cosmetics, silk protein helps improve softness, shine, and a conditioned feel by forming a light protective film and binding water. It is not associated with key concern groups such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde-releasing preservatives, mineral oil, silicones, or heavy metals. Rarely, individuals with strong sensitivity to proteins may experience mild irritation, so patch testing is advisable for very reactive skin.","category":"Protein / Conditioning agent"}

butylated hydroxytoluene (bht)__skincare.analysis: {"name":"Butylated Hydroxytoluene (bht)","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"BHT is a synthetic antioxidant used to prevent oils in products from oxidizing and going rancid. It is generally permitted in cosmetics but is somewhat controversial due to potential irritation and systemic effects at higher exposures.","details":"In skincare, BHT helps stabilize formulas and extend shelf life, but it can cause irritation or sensitization in some individuals, especially with leave-on products used around the eyes or on compromised skin. Some laboratory and animal studies raise concerns about endocrine disruption and organ toxicity at high doses, though typical cosmetic concentrations are much lower and considered acceptable by major regulators. People seeking very low-toxicity or “clean” formulations often choose to avoid BHT as a precaution.","category":"Synthetic antioxidant / preservative"}

sodium hyaluronate__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Sodium Hyaluronate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Sodium hyaluronate is the salt form of hyaluronic acid and is widely used as a hydrating and plumping ingredient. It is generally considered safe and beneficial for most skin types, including sensitive skin.","details":"This ingredient attracts and holds water in the skin, helping improve hydration, elasticity, and the appearance of fine lines. It is well-tolerated, with a very low risk of irritation or allergy in cosmetic use. Different molecular weights can affect how deeply it penetrates, but this mainly influences performance, not safety, for typical skincare concentrations.","category":"Humectant / moisturizing agent"}

potassium sorbate__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Potassium Sorbate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Potassium sorbate is a preservative used to inhibit the growth of mold, yeast, and some bacteria in skincare and haircare products. It is generally regarded as a mild and relatively safe preservative at typical cosmetic use levels.","details":"This ingredient is the potassium salt of sorbic acid and is widely used in both foods and cosmetics due to its good safety record. In rare cases, it can cause mild irritation or allergic contact reactions, especially on very sensitive or damaged skin, but it is usually well tolerated. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, or heavy metal, and is often accepted in more natural or organic-leaning formulations.","category":"Preservative"}

citric acid__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Citric Acid","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Citric acid is a fruit-derived alpha-hydroxy acid used mainly to adjust pH and provide mild exfoliation in skincare and haircare products. It is generally well tolerated but can irritate very sensitive or compromised skin at higher concentrations.","details":"In cosmetic formulations, citric acid primarily functions as a pH adjuster and chelating agent, helping stabilize products and mildly promoting cell turnover. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, fragrance, mineral oil, silicone, drying alcohol, or heavy metal. Potential concerns are mostly limited to stinging or irritation in those with barrier damage, very sensitive skin, or when combined with other exfoliating acids.","category":"pH adjuster / mild exfoliating acid"}

tocopherol (vitamin e)__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Tocopherol (vitamin E)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Tocopherol, also known as Vitamin E, is an antioxidant commonly used in skincare to protect the skin and the formula from oxidative damage. It is generally considered safe and beneficial for most skin types.","details":"In skincare products, tocopherol helps neutralize free radicals, supports skin barrier function, and can improve the stability of oils in the formula. It has a low risk of irritation, though very sensitive or allergy-prone individuals may occasionally experience contact dermatitis. Tocopherol is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, or drying alcohol, and is widely regarded as a safe, supportive ingredient in cosmetic formulations.","category":"Antioxidant / Skin conditioning"}

isopropanol__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Isopropanol","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Isopropanol (isopropyl alcohol) is a volatile drying alcohol used mainly as a solvent and for quick-drying formulas in skincare and haircare. It can be irritating and drying, especially for sensitive or compromised skin and with frequent use.","details":"As a low–molecular weight alcohol, isopropanol can strip skin lipids and disrupt the skin barrier, leading to dryness, stinging, or redness, particularly in leave-on products or when used often. It is generally safe from a systemic toxicity standpoint at cosmetic levels, but may worsen irritation, eczema, or rosacea and can sting around the eyes or broken skin. Its main concerns are barrier disruption and irritation rather than hormonal or carcinogenic effects.","category":"Drying alcohol / solvent"}

sodium metabisulfite__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Sodium Metabisulfite","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Sodium metabisulfite is an antioxidant and preservative that helps prevent product oxidation and discoloration. It can trigger sensitivity or allergic reactions in some individuals, particularly those sensitive to sulfites.","details":"In skincare and haircare, sodium metabisulfite helps stabilize formulas by scavenging oxygen, which can prolong shelf life. However, sulfite compounds are known potential allergens and may cause redness, itching, or dermatitis in susceptible users, and can be problematic for those with sulfite sensitivity or asthma when inhaled from sprays. It is not the same as sulfate surfactants (like SLS/SLES), but it is still a sensitizing preservative that some people may prefer to avoid.","category":"Antioxidant / preservative (sulfite)"}

disodium edta__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Disodium Edta","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Disodium EDTA is a chelating agent used to bind metal ions and improve product stability and performance. It is generally considered low risk at typical cosmetic concentrations, with irritation being uncommon.","details":"By binding calcium, magnesium, and trace metals, disodium EDTA helps prevent product degradation, rancidity, and changes in color or texture, and it can enhance the effectiveness of preservatives. It has a long history of cosmetic use and is usually well tolerated on skin, although very sensitive individuals may rarely experience mild irritation. Environmental persistence is a concern at larger industrial scales, but in personal care products it is considered a relatively safe and non-sensitizing helper ingredient.","category":"Chelating agent / stabilizer"}

sodium phosphate__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Sodium Phosphate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Sodium phosphate is an inorganic salt used mainly as a pH buffer or chelating agent in skincare and haircare products. It is generally considered low risk at typical cosmetic concentrations.","details":"In formulations, sodium phosphate helps stabilize pH and can improve product stability and texture. It does not belong to major concern groups like parabens, sulfates (SLS/SLES), phthalates, formaldehyde releasers, or heavy metals. Skin irritation is uncommon and usually limited to very sensitive individuals or when used in unusually high concentrations.","category":"pH adjuster / buffering agent"}

sodium hydroxide__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Sodium Hydroxide","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Sodium hydroxide is a strong alkali used in very small amounts to adjust the pH of skincare and haircare products. While highly caustic in pure form, it is typically safe in low concentrations when properly neutralized in finished formulas.","details":"In cosmetics, sodium hydroxide helps bring the product pH into a skin-compatible range and is not associated with parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde release, or heavy metals. However, because it is inherently irritating and corrosive at higher levels, poorly formulated products or overconcentrated use could cause irritation, especially on compromised or very sensitive skin. Its risk is mainly formulation-dependent rather than from the ingredient’s presence at standard low levels.","category":"pH adjuster / alkalizing agent"}

water__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Water","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Water is a common base ingredient in skincare and haircare products and is generally considered very safe. It helps dissolve other ingredients and hydrate the skin surface.","details":"In cosmetic formulations, purified water acts as a solvent, allowing active and supportive ingredients to be distributed evenly and absorbed more easily. It does not belong to the major concern categories like parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde releasers, or drying alcohols. Any risk is typically related only to contamination if manufacturing practices are poor, not to the water itself.","category":"Solvent / Base ingredient"}

cetearyl alcohol__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Cetearyl Alcohol","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Cetearyl Alcohol is a fatty alcohol used as an emollient, thickener, and stabilizer in skincare and haircare products. It is generally considered safe and non-irritating for most skin types.","details":"Unlike drying simple alcohols (such as ethanol or isopropyl alcohol), Cetearyl Alcohol is a waxy, fatty alcohol derived from plant or synthetic sources that helps soften and smooth the skin and hair. It can improve texture and spreadability of formulations and support the stability of emulsions. A small number of individuals with very sensitive or compromised skin may experience mild irritation or contact allergy, but this is uncommon.","category":"Fatty alcohol / Emollient"}

dimethicone__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Dimethicone","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Dimethicone is a silicone-based polymer used to create a smooth, silky feel and to reduce water loss from the skin or hair. It is generally considered safe and non-irritating for most people.","details":"As an occlusive and emollient, dimethicone forms a breathable barrier on the skin or hair that helps lock in moisture and improve texture and slip. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, or formaldehyde-releasing preservative, and it is not associated with heavy metal contamination. Some users with very acne-prone or sensitive skin may find that heavy or layered silicone use feels occlusive, so patch testing and overall routine balance are advisable.","category":"Silicone / Emollient"}

panthenol__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Panthenol","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Panthenol (provitamin B5) is a humectant and conditioning agent that attracts and holds moisture in skin and hair. It is widely regarded as gentle and beneficial for barrier support.","details":"In skincare and haircare, panthenol helps improve hydration, softness, and elasticity while supporting the skin barrier and soothing minor irritation. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releaser, or heavy metal, and it is not an alcohol in the drying, irritant sense. Allergic reactions are rare but can occur in highly sensitive individuals, so patch testing is still recommended for very reactive skin.","category":"Humectant / Provitamin B5"}

panthenyl ethyl ether__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Panthenyl Ethyl Ether","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Panthenyl Ethyl Ether is a modified derivative of panthenol used for its moisturizing and conditioning properties. It is generally considered safe and well tolerated in cosmetic use.","details":"This ingredient functions similarly to panthenol, helping to improve moisture retention, smoothness, and overall condition of skin and hair, often with enhanced stability or penetration. It is not related to parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde-releasing preservatives, fragrance, mineral oil, or heavy metals. Adverse reactions are uncommon, but very sensitive users may still wish to patch test new products containing it.","category":"Humectant / Conditioning agent"}

hydroxyethylcellulose__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Hydroxyethylcellulose","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Hydroxyethylcellulose is a cellulose-derived polymer used as a thickener and stabilizer in skincare and haircare products. It is generally considered very safe and non-irritating for most skin types.","details":"This ingredient helps adjust texture and viscosity, improving spreadability and stability of gels, creams, and serums without contributing to comedogenicity. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde releaser, silicone, mineral oil, drying alcohol, or heavy metal. Adverse reactions are rare and usually limited to individuals with extreme sensitivities to certain polymers.","category":"Polymer thickener / texture enhancer"}

undecane__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Undecane","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Undecane is a lightweight hydrocarbon used as an emollient and solvent alternative to silicones in skincare and haircare. It is generally considered safe and non-sensitizing for most users.","details":"It provides a light, non-greasy feel, helps dissolve other ingredients, and can enhance spreadability without the occlusiveness of heavier oils or petrolatum. It is not classified as a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, fragrance, mineral oil, silicone, drying alcohol, or heavy metal. Irritation potential is low, though very sensitive or acne-prone individuals may wish to patch test any product containing new emollients.","category":"Emollient / solvent"}

tridecane__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Tridecane","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Tridecane is a lightweight, volatile hydrocarbon used as an emollient and texture enhancer, often as a silicone alternative. It typically has a low risk of irritation and is considered safe in cosmetic use.","details":"It contributes to a smooth, quick-drying, non-greasy skin feel and can help distribute other formula components evenly on the skin or hair. Tridecane is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, fragrance component, mineral oil, silicone, drying alcohol, or heavy metal. Adverse reactions are uncommon, but patch testing is still advisable for highly reactive or sensitive skin types.","category":"Emollient / texture enhancer"}

hexyl cinnamal__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Hexyl Cinnamal","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Hexyl Cinnamal is a synthetic fragrance ingredient that gives a jasmine-like scent. It is a common skin allergen, especially for people with sensitive or compromised skin.","details":"This ingredient is widely used in skincare, haircare, and perfumes to provide a floral fragrance note and is part of the EU-declared fragrance allergens list. It does not act like parabens, sulfates, or phthalates, but it can trigger allergic contact dermatitis, redness, or irritation in susceptible individuals. Patch testing or avoidance is advisable for those with fragrance sensitivities or eczema.","category":"Fragrance allergen"}

limonene__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Limonene","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Limonene is a citrus-derived fragrance and solvent compound that gives products a lemon-like scent. It can oxidize when exposed to air and then become a strong skin sensitizer.","details":"Although naturally occurring in citrus oils, limonene is regulated as a fragrance allergen because its oxidation products can cause allergic contact dermatitis and irritation. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, or formaldehyde-releaser, but its fragrance and sensitizing potential are the main concerns in skincare and haircare. People with sensitive skin, rosacea, or a history of fragrance allergy may prefer to avoid leave-on products that contain limonene.","category":"Fragrance allergen"}

tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes_.analysis: {"name":"Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes (often known as AHTN or tonalide-type musk) is a synthetic fragrance compound used to provide a musky, long-lasting scent. It has raised concerns about persistence in the environment and potential bioaccumulation.","details":"In skincare and haircare, this ingredient functions purely as a fragrance and, like other synthetic musks, may cause irritation or allergic reactions in some individuals. While typical cosmetic levels are within regulatory limits, it is not essential for product performance and offers no skin benefit, only scent. People aiming to minimize fragrance exposure or potential long-term environmental and bioaccumulative chemicals may choose to avoid it.","category":"Synthetic musk fragrance"}

salvia officinalis (sage) extract__skinc.analysis: {"name":"Salvia Officinalis (sage) Extract","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Sage extract is a plant-derived ingredient used for its antioxidant, soothing, and antimicrobial properties in skincare. It is generally well tolerated but may cause irritation or allergy in sensitive individuals, especially at higher concentrations.","details":"Salvia officinalis (sage) extract contains polyphenols and essential oils that can provide antioxidant and mild astringent benefits, which may help with oily or blemish-prone skin. However, components such as camphor and thujone in sage essential oil fractions can be sensitizing for some people, particularly those with reactive or compromised skin. In typical cosmetic use levels and when properly formulated, it is considered safe, but patch testing is advisable for very sensitive users.","category":"Botanical extract / antioxidant"}

tocopherol__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Tocopherol","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Tocopherol is a form of vitamin E commonly used as an antioxidant to protect both the formula and the skin from oxidative damage.","details":"It helps stabilize oils in the product and may provide moisturizing and barrier-supportive benefits to the skin. It is widely regarded as safe, though very sensitive individuals may experience mild irritation or contact allergy at higher concentrations.","category":"Antioxidant / Vitamin E"}

behentrimonium methosulfate__skincare__e.analysis: {"name":"Behentrimonium Methosulfate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Behentrimonium methosulfate is a conditioning agent and emulsifier used mainly in haircare and some skincare products to improve softness, detangling, and spreadability.","details":"Despite the name, it is not a harsh sulfate surfactant; it is a quaternary ammonium compound derived from rapeseed oil that binds to hair and provides conditioning. It is generally considered safe and non-irritating in rinse-off and leave-on products, though some people with very sensitive skin may experience mild irritation.","category":"Conditioning agent / Emulsifier"}

magnesium nitrate__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Magnesium Nitrate","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Magnesium Nitrate is an inorganic salt sometimes used as a stabilizer or component in preservative systems in cosmetics. It can contribute to skin or eye irritation in some individuals, especially at higher concentrations or in leave-on products.","details":"In skincare and haircare, Magnesium Nitrate is often paired with other ingredients (such as diazolidinyl urea) to support preservation, and in such systems it may be associated with mild irritation potential. While not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, or formaldehyde-releasing agent itself, it can enhance the performance of preservative blends that may be sensitizing for some users. People with very sensitive or compromised skin, or those prone to irritation, may prefer formulations that minimize or avoid this type of inorganic nitrate salt, particularly in products intended for prolonged skin contact.","category":"Inorganic salt / preservative helper"}

disodium phosphate__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Disodium Phosphate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Disodium Phosphate is a buffering and chelating agent used to help control pH and product stability in skincare and haircare. It is generally considered to have low irritation potential at typical cosmetic use levels.","details":"This ingredient helps maintain the desired acidity/alkalinity of a formula, which can improve the effectiveness and comfort of skincare products. It is not related to parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde-releasing preservatives, fragrances, mineral oils, silicones, or heavy metals, and is typically well tolerated even by sensitive skin when used at standard concentrations. Adverse reactions are uncommon and usually limited to rare cases of individual sensitivity.","category":"Buffering agent / chelating agent"}

stearamidopropyl dimethylamine__skincare.analysis: {"name":"Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine is a conditioning agent and emulsifier commonly used in haircare and some skincare products. It is generally considered safe with a low risk of irritation for most users.","details":"This ingredient is derived from fatty acids and helps detangle, soften, and smooth hair or improve the texture of creams and lotions. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releaser, fragrance, mineral oil, silicone, alcohol, or heavy metal. Mild irritation is possible in very sensitive or compromised skin, but it is uncommon at typical cosmetic concentrations.","category":"Conditioning agent / emulsifier"}

melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree) leaf w.analysis: {"name":"Melaleuca Alternifolia (tea Tree) Leaf Water","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Tea tree leaf water is a diluted, water-based derivative of tea tree with mild antimicrobial and soothing properties. It is generally well tolerated but can still cause irritation in very sensitive or reactive skin.","details":"Compared with tea tree essential oil, tea tree leaf water contains much lower concentrations of potentially irritating terpenes, which reduces but does not completely remove the risk of redness, stinging, or contact allergy. It is commonly used in products for oily or blemish-prone skin due to its antibacterial and refreshing effects. Patch testing is recommended for those with sensitive skin or a known history of reactions to essential oils.","category":"Botanical extract / soothing and antimicrobial agent"}

citrus limon (lemon) fruit extract__skin.analysis: {"name":"Citrus Limon (lemon) Fruit Extract","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Lemon fruit extract is a citrus-derived ingredient often used for brightening and antioxidant benefits, but it can be irritating and increase photosensitivity in some people. Those with sensitive or reactive skin may experience stinging, redness, or allergic reactions, especially with sun exposure.","details":"This extract may contain natural fruit acids and aromatic compounds that can disrupt the skin barrier or trigger irritation, particularly at higher concentrations or in leave-on products. Some components of citrus extracts can be phototoxic, potentially increasing the risk of sun sensitivity or pigmentation changes if adequate sun protection is not used. It does not belong to parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or formaldehyde-releasing preservatives, but it is still considered a common botanical irritant and possible allergen in skincare.","category":"Botanical extract / brightening and antioxidant agent"}

polyquaternium-47__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Polyquaternium-47","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Polyquaternium-47 is a conditioning polymer used to improve texture, detangling, and smoothness in skincare and haircare products. It is generally considered low risk for most users.","details":"As a cationic polymer, Polyquaternium-47 deposits a thin film on skin or hair to enhance softness, reduce static, and improve manageability. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, fragrance, mineral oil, petrolatum, silicone, drying alcohol, or heavy metal. Irritation or sensitivity is uncommon and usually limited to very sensitive or compromised skin.","category":"Conditioning polymer / film-former"}

glycerin__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Glycerin","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Glycerin is a humectant that attracts water to the skin, helping to maintain hydration and barrier function. It is widely used and considered very safe for most skin types.","details":"In skincare and haircare, glycerin helps draw moisture into the outer layers, supporting softness and reducing dryness without being occlusive like heavy mineral oils. It is not associated with hormone disruption, does not belong to sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde releasers, fragrance, silicones, or drying alcohols, and has a long history of safe cosmetic use. Rarely, very high concentrations may feel sticky or cause mild irritation on extremely sensitive skin.","category":"Humectant / moisturizer"}

glyceryl stearate__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Glyceryl Stearate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Glyceryl Stearate is an emollient and emulsifier that helps blend oil and water and gives products a smooth, creamy texture. It is generally considered low risk and well tolerated.","details":"This ingredient is derived from glycerin and stearic acid and helps soften skin while stabilizing creams and lotions. It does not fall into higher-concern groups such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde-releasing preservatives, synthetic fragrance, mineral oil/petrolatum, silicones, drying alcohols, or heavy metals. Adverse reactions are uncommon and usually limited to rare individual sensitivities.","category":"Emollient / emulsifier"}

polysorbate 60__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Polysorbate 60","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Polysorbate 60 is an emulsifier that helps blend oil and water in skincare and haircare products. It is generally considered safe with a low irritation potential for most users.","details":"In cosmetics, Polysorbate 60 improves texture and stability of creams and lotions, helping active ingredients disperse evenly on the skin or hair. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releaser, or heavy metal. Rarely, sensitive individuals may experience mild irritation or contact dermatitis, especially at higher concentrations or on compromised skin.","category":"Emulsifier / Solubilizer"}

silica__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Silica","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Silica is used in skincare and haircare as an absorbent, anti-caking, and texture-enhancing ingredient. It is generally considered low risk in its cosmetic, non-inhaled forms.","details":"Cosmetic-grade silica can help control shine, improve slip, and give products a smooth, matte finish. The primary safety concern with silica relates to inhalation of fine crystalline dust in occupational settings, not typical topical cosmetic use where amorphous forms and low airborne exposure are standard. It is not related to parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde, fragrance, mineral oil, silicones, drying alcohols, or heavy metals.","category":"Absorbent / Texture agent"}

magnesium chloride__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Magnesium Chloride","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Magnesium chloride is a mineral salt used for its stabilizing, humectant, and skin-conditioning properties in skincare and haircare. It is generally low risk when used at cosmetic concentrations.","details":"In formulations, magnesium chloride can help maintain product stability and may support skin hydration and barrier function. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, synthetic fragrance, mineral oil, silicone, drying alcohol, or heavy metal. Some people with very sensitive or broken skin may feel transient stinging or irritation from salt-based ingredients.","category":"Mineral salt / Skin-conditioning agent"}

methylchloroisothiazolinone__skincare__e.analysis: {"name":"Methylchloroisothiazolinone","riskLevel":"high","summary":"Methylchloroisothiazolinone is a synthetic preservative associated with a high risk of skin sensitization and allergic contact dermatitis, especially in leave-on products. It is often regulated and restricted due to its strong allergenic potential.","details":"This ingredient belongs to the isothiazolinone class of preservatives and is frequently used in combination with methylisothiazolinone to prevent microbial growth. Numerous clinical reports link it to eczema, redness, itching, and rashes, particularly in people with sensitive or compromised skin. Many regulatory bodies have limited or banned its use in leave-on cosmetics because the risk of sensitization often outweighs its preservative benefits.","category":"Preservative (isothiazolinone)"}

methylisothiazolinone__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Methylisothiazolinone","riskLevel":"high","summary":"Methylisothiazolinone is a powerful preservative with a high risk of causing allergic contact dermatitis and skin irritation. It has been heavily scrutinized and restricted in many regions, especially in leave-on skincare products.","details":"Used to control bacteria and fungi in cosmetic formulations, methylisothiazolinone is effective at very low concentrations but is also a well-documented skin sensitizer. Prolonged or repeated exposure can trigger allergic reactions, including redness, itching, and eczema-like rashes, particularly in individuals with sensitive skin. Due to widespread sensitization cases, many brands and regulatory authorities now avoid or tightly limit its use in leave-on personal care products.","category":"Preservative (isothiazolinone)"}

parfum (fragrance)__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Parfum (fragrance)","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Parfum (fragrance) is a generic term for a mixture of scenting chemicals and solvents used to add smell to products. It is a common source of skin irritation and allergic reactions, especially for sensitive or reactive skin types.","details":"Because 'fragrance' is a catch-all term, it can include many different substances, including potential allergens and, in some cases, phthalates or other sensitizing compounds, without being individually disclosed. It is a frequent trigger for contact dermatitis, redness, or itching in people with sensitive skin, eczema, or rosacea. While many people tolerate fragrance well, those prone to irritation or allergies are often advised to choose fragrance-free or unscented products.","category":"Fragrance / Allergen"}

alcohol__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Alcohol","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"In skincare, ‘alcohol’ usually refers to low–molecular weight drying alcohols such as ethanol, denatured alcohol, or isopropyl alcohol. These can increase penetration of other ingredients but may disrupt the skin barrier, especially at higher concentrations.","details":"Drying alcohols evaporate quickly and give formulas a light, non-greasy feel, but they can strip natural oils, leading to dryness, irritation, or sensitivity, particularly for dry or compromised skin. The actual risk depends on type and amount; small amounts in otherwise well-formulated products are often tolerated, but high levels or frequent use may worsen redness, flaking, or breakouts for some people. This ingredient is distinct from fatty or moisturizing alcohols (like cetyl or stearyl alcohol), which are generally gentler.","category":"Alcohols (drying types)"}

bht__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Bht","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"BHT (butylated hydroxytoluene) is a synthetic antioxidant used to prevent oils and fragrances in cosmetics from going rancid. It is effective at stabilizing products but is somewhat controversial due to concerns about potential hormone and organ effects at high doses in animal studies.","details":"In skincare and haircare, BHT is typically used at low concentrations, and major regulators currently consider it permissible at these levels, but some consumers prefer to avoid it as a precaution. It can occasionally trigger irritation or allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, especially with leave-on products used over long periods. Overall risk in typical cosmetic use appears limited but not negligible, leading some brands to choose alternative antioxidants.","category":"Synthetic antioxidant / preservative"}

olealkonium chloride__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Olealkonium Chloride","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Olealkonium chloride is a quaternary ammonium compound used mainly as a surfactant and conditioning or antimicrobial agent. It can be irritating to skin and eyes, especially at higher concentrations or in leave-on products.","details":"As a cationic surfactant, olealkonium chloride helps with product spreadability and conditioning, particularly in haircare. However, quaternary ammonium compounds can disrupt the skin barrier and may cause irritation or sensitization in some individuals, especially those with sensitive or compromised skin. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releaser, or heavy metal, but its irritation potential justifies a moderate risk rating.","category":"Cationic surfactant / Conditioning agent"}

oleyl alcohol__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Oleyl Alcohol","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Oleyl alcohol is a fatty alcohol used as an emollient, thickener, and emulsifier in skincare and haircare. It is generally considered non-irritating and skin-friendly for most people.","details":"Unlike simple drying alcohols such as ethanol or isopropyl alcohol, oleyl alcohol is a long-chain fatty alcohol that helps soften and condition skin and hair and improve texture of formulations. It rarely causes irritation or sensitization, though very sensitive individuals can occasionally react to any ingredient. It does not belong to problematic groups like parabens, sulfates, phthalates, formaldehyde-releasing preservatives, or silicones.","category":"Fatty alcohol / Emollient"}

peg-2m__skincare__en.analysis: {"name":"Peg-2m","riskLevel":"low","summary":"PEG-2M is a polyethylene glycol polymer used as a film-former, thickener, and skin-conditioning agent. It is generally regarded as low risk in rinse-off and most leave-on products when properly purified.","details":"PEG ingredients can theoretically contain trace impurities (such as ethylene oxide or 1,4-dioxane) from manufacturing, but reputable formulators use highly purified grades that meet safety standards. PEG-2M helps improve texture, spreadability, and moisture retention without being known as a common irritant or sensitizer. It is not a paraben, sulfate, phthalate, formaldehyde-releasing preservative, or heavy metal, and is not a drying alcohol.","category":"PEG polymer / Texture and conditioning agent"}

水__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"水","riskLevel":"low","summary":"水是护肤品中最常见的溶剂和基质，一般被认为非常安全。它用于溶解其他成分并帮助产品均匀涂抹在皮肤上。","details":"护肤配方中通常使用纯化水或去离子水，以减少杂质和微生物污染的风险。水本身不会刺激皮肤，也不属于防腐剂、表面活性剂、激素干扰物或重金属来源。总体来说，水在护肤和护发产品中是低风险且必需的基础成分。","category":"溶剂/基质"}

泛醇乙醚__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"泛醇乙醚","riskLevel":"low","summary":"泛醇乙醚是一种维生素B5（泛醇）的衍生物，常用于护肤和护发产品中，具有保湿和舒缓功效。总体安全性较高，刺激性较低。","details":"泛醇乙醚能够在皮肤和头发表面形成保湿薄膜，帮助提升柔软度和光泽，同时有助于修护受损屏障。现有资料中，它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、矿物油或硅油，也不被归类为常见的强致敏香精成分。极少数敏感人群可能出现轻微刺激或过敏，应在大面积使用前进行局部测试。","category":"保湿剂 / 护理剂"}

氯化镁__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"氯化镁","riskLevel":"low","summary":"氯化镁是一种无机盐，常用于护肤品中作为保湿剂和矿物补充成分。总体安全性较高，刺激性较低。","details":"在化妆品和护肤品中，氯化镁可帮助维持皮肤水分平衡，并支持皮肤屏障功能。一般浓度下对大多数肤质较为温和，但极少数敏感肌在破损皮肤或高浓度使用时可能出现轻微刺痛或刺激感。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐表活剂、邻苯二甲酸酯、释放甲醛防腐剂、矿物油或硅油类成分，也不属于常见的内分泌干扰物。","category":"无机矿物成分 / 保湿辅助成分"}

氢氧化钠__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"氢氧化钠","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"氢氧化钠是一种强碱，在护肤和洗护产品中主要用来调节配方的酸碱度。低浓度、被良好中和后通常较安全，但高浓度会刺激甚至灼伤皮肤和眼睛。","details":"在化妆品中，氢氧化钠常以极低用量出现，用于调节 pH，使配方更接近皮肤适宜的酸碱度，正常使用条件下对大多数人较为安全。未被充分中和或浓度过高时，可能引起皮肤和眼周强烈刺激、刺痛和干燥，对敏感肌或屏障受损人群更需注意。配方合格的成品中，其自由态含量通常极低，一般不会造成腐蚀性伤害。","category":"pH调节剂 / 碱性成分"}

甘油硬脂酸酯__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"甘油硬脂酸酯","riskLevel":"low","summary":"甘油硬脂酸酯是一种常用的乳化剂和皮肤润肤剂，通常被认为安全性较高。它有助于让配方中的油水充分混合，并让皮肤感觉柔软顺滑。","details":"甘油硬脂酸酯来源可以是植物油或合成原料，在护肤和护发产品中主要用于稳定乳液结构并提升涂抹肤感。现有研究显示其刺激性较低，一般肤质包括敏感肌都较易耐受。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、矿物油或硅油等高关注成分，致痘性也偏低，整体风险较小。","category":"乳化剂 / 润肤剂"}

磷酸氢二钠__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"磷酸氢二钠","riskLevel":"low","summary":"磷酸氢二钠是一种无机盐，常用作护肤品中的缓冲剂和螯合剂，帮助稳定配方的酸碱度。一般认为对皮肤刺激性较低，属于相对安全的成分。","details":"在护肤和洗护产品中，磷酸氢二钠主要用于维持配方pH稳定，提升产品整体的稳定性和使用感受。正常浓度下很少引起过敏或刺激，敏感肌通常也可以耐受。极少数人可能对无机盐类有轻微刺激或不适，通常通过降低使用频率或停用相关产品即可缓解。","category":"pH调节剂 / 缓冲剂"}

二氧化硅__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"二氧化硅","riskLevel":"low","summary":"二氧化硅在护肤品中常用作吸油、增稠和改善肤感的成分，一般被认为安全性较高。正常用量下对大多数肤质刺激性较低。","details":"在外用护肤和彩妆产品中，二氧化硅多以非可吸入的颗粒或球形粉体形式存在，可帮助控制油光、使肤感柔滑，并改善产品延展性。少数极度敏感或受损皮肤人群可能出现轻微干燥或不适，建议首次使用新产品时先小范围测试。需要注意的是，其主要安全顾虑集中在职业环境中长期吸入粉尘，与普通护肤品外用情境不同，因此日常使用风险较低。","category":"功能性填充剂 / 吸附剂"}

十一烷__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"十一烷","riskLevel":"low","summary":"十一烷是一种合成烃类溶剂与润肤剂，常用于护肤品中提供柔滑肤感和轻盈的油性感。通常被认为安全性较高，不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐或邻苯二甲酸酯等高风险成分。","details":"在配方中，十一烷主要用作溶剂、质地调理剂和挥发性载体，可帮助产品在皮肤上更易延展并减少油腻感。现有研究中，其刺激性和致敏性较低，一般对大多数肤质（包括油性和混合性皮肤）较为友好。对极度敏感或受损皮肤人群，仍建议首次使用时进行局部测试以排除个体不耐受。","category":"溶剂与润肤剂"}

柠檬烯__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"柠檬烯","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"柠檬烯是一种来自柑橘类精油的香味成分，常用于护肤品和洗发产品中。对大多数人来说是安全的，但氧化后容易引起过敏和刺激。","details":"柠檬烯主要起到增添清新柑橘香味的作用，属于常见的香精成分之一。其本身相对安全，但在空气中易被氧化，氧化产物可增加皮肤致敏风险，尤其是敏感肌、湿疹肌或有香精过敏史的人群应注意。配方中若与抗氧化成分同用并密封良好，可在一定程度上降低其致敏可能。","category":"香精/香料成分"}

泛醇（维生素b5原）__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"泛醇（维生素B5原）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"泛醇是一种常见的保湿和舒缓成分，广泛用于护肤和护发产品中，一般安全性较高。对大多数肤质都较为温和，敏感肌通常也能耐受。","details":"泛醇能在皮肤中转化为维生素B5，帮助增强皮肤屏障、提升保湿能力并减轻干燥紧绷感。它具有一定的舒缓、修护功效，可用于晒后修护、屏障受损和染烫后发质护理。极少数人可能会出现轻微刺激或接触性过敏，但整体发生率较低，且与防腐剂、香精、重金属等高风险成分无明显关联。","category":"保湿舒缓成分"}

柠檬果提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"柠檬果提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"柠檬果提取物常用于护肤品中，具有一定的抗氧化和提亮肤色作用。总体来说安全性较高，但在敏感肌或受损皮肤上可能引起轻微刺激。","details":"柠檬果提取物主要含有果酸、维生素C及多种植物多酚，有助于温和去角质、改善暗沉和提供抗氧化保护。由于其中可能含有天然香精成分及光敏成分，部分敏感肌或易光敏人群在日晒条件下使用时，可能出现刺痛、发红或轻微光敏反应。配方中若浓度较低且搭配保湿、舒缓成分，一般耐受性较好，使用时注意防晒可降低潜在风险。","category":"植物提取物 / 抗氧化成分"}

油烷铵氯化物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"油烷铵氯化物","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"油烷铵氯化物是一种季铵盐类阳离子表面活性剂和防腐成分，常用于护肤和护发产品中以提供抗菌和调理效果。一般浓度下对大多数人较为安全，但可能刺激敏感肌或受损皮肤。","details":"作为阳离子表面活性剂，油烷铵氯化物能帮助产品抑制部分细菌生长并改善产品稳定性，同时在护发产品中有一定的顺滑、抗静电作用。部分季铵盐类对皮肤和眼周具有一定刺激性，尤其在高浓度或停留型产品中需注意敏感人群可能出现刺痒、发红等不适。对孕期、婴幼儿使用时建议选择含量较低或经专门安全评估的配方。","category":"防腐剂 / 表面活性剂"}

羟乙基纤维素__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"羟乙基纤维素","riskLevel":"low","summary":"羟乙基纤维素是一种源自纤维素的增稠剂和稳定剂，常用于护肤和洗护产品中改善质地和流动性。整体安全性较高，一般皮肤耐受性良好。","details":"羟乙基纤维素主要起到增稠、成膜和稳定配方的作用，可帮助产品更顺滑、易推开，并减少分层现象。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、硅油或矿物油等高争议成分，也不是常见的致敏香精来源。少数极度敏感或受损皮肤在高浓度或复杂配方中可能出现轻微刺激或不适，一般停用后即可缓解。","category":"增稠剂/稳定剂/成膜剂"}

甲基异噻唑啉酮__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"甲基异噻唑啉酮","riskLevel":"high","summary":"甲基异噻唑啉酮是一种常用于护肤品、洗发水等产品中的防腐剂，具有较强的抗菌作用。它被认为是较高致敏风险成分，尤其容易引起接触性皮炎和皮肤刺激。","details":"甲基异噻唑啉酮属于异噻唑啉酮类防腐剂，已被多国监管机构限制在免洗类化妆品中的使用，主要因为其会导致过敏性接触性皮炎、红斑、瘙痒等皮肤不良反应。敏感肌、湿疹肌或已有皮肤屏障受损人群接触后更容易发生刺激与过敏，长期或高频接触也可能加重皮肤敏感状态。在清洗型产品中短暂接触风险相对较低，但仍建议敏感人群谨慎选择或避免。","category":"防腐剂"}

药用鼠尾草（salvia officinalis）提取物__skincare__.analysis: {"name":"药用鼠尾草（Salvia Officinalis）提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"药用鼠尾草提取物常用于护肤品中，具有抗氧化、舒缓和调理皮脂的作用。一般皮肤耐受性较好，致敏率较低。","details":"作为植物提取物，药用鼠尾草富含多酚类成分，可帮助中和自由基，减缓肌肤氧化损伤，并有助于控油与收敛毛孔。少数敏感肌或对芳香植物提取物过敏的人，可能出现轻微刺激或过敏，应先进行局部测试。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、矿物油或硅油等高争议成分，整体安全性较高。","category":"植物提取物 / 舒缓抗氧化成分"}

硬脂酰胺丙基二甲胺__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"硬脂酰胺丙基二甲胺","riskLevel":"low","summary":"硬脂酰胺丙基二甲胺是一种常用的护发调理剂和表面活性剂，常见于洗发水和护发素中，用于柔顺和易梳理头发。总体安全性较高，对环境的生物降解性也较好。","details":"该成分通过中和阴离子表面活性剂残留来减少头发打结，使头发更加柔软顺滑。少数敏感人群或受损头皮可能出现轻微刺激或过敏，如瘙痒、刺痛或发红，但在正常使用浓度下较少见。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或释放甲醛类成分，也不是矿物油、硅油或重金属成分，整体风险较低。","category":"护发调理剂 / 阳离子表面活性剂"}

磷酸钠__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"磷酸钠","riskLevel":"low","summary":"磷酸钠在护肤品中常用作缓冲剂和螯合剂，一般被认为安全性较高。正常使用条件下对皮肤刺激性较低。","details":"磷酸钠可以帮助调节配方的酸碱度并稳定产品，减少金属离子对配方的破坏。对大多数肤质来说耐受性良好，但极度敏感或受损皮肤在高浓度或多种刺激成分叠加时，可能出现轻微刺激或干燥。它不是防腐剂、硫酸盐表活、邻苯二甲酸酯或甲醛释放体，也与矿物油、硅油和重金属无直接关联。","category":"pH缓冲剂 / 螯合剂"}

聚二甲基硅氧烷（dimethicone）__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"聚二甲基硅氧烷（Dimethicone）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"聚二甲基硅氧烷是一种常见的硅油成分，用于在皮肤表面形成光滑保护膜，提升润滑感和柔滑度。一般被认为安全性较高，刺激性较低。","details":"在护肤和护发产品中，聚二甲基硅氧烷主要起到保湿锁水、填平细小纹理和改善触感的作用，可减轻干燥紧绷感。其成膜特性可能在极少数易长痘或毛孔易堵塞人群中引发闷痘，但并非典型致痘成分。总体而言，该成分不属于防腐剂、激素干扰物或强刺激表活，敏感肌通常也可以耐受。","category":"硅油 / 皮肤保护剂"}

甲基氯异噻唑啉酮__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"甲基氯异噻唑啉酮","riskLevel":"high","summary":"甲基氯异噻唑啉酮是一种强效防腐剂，已知具有较高致敏和刺激风险，尤其在免洗类护肤、护发产品中更受争议。对敏感肌、婴幼儿和有皮炎史人群可能带来较大刺激或过敏风险。","details":"该成分常与甲基异噻唑啉酮（MIT）联合使用，用于抑制细菌和真菌生长，但被广泛报道与接触性皮炎、红斑和瘙痒相关。欧盟已大幅限制其在免洗类化妆品中的使用，仅在低浓度冲洗类产品中仍被允许。长期或反复接触可能增加致敏几率，因此敏感肌、受损皮肤及婴幼儿人群建议尽量避免或减少使用含有该成分的产品。","category":"防腐剂 / 潜在过敏原"}

己基肉桂醛__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"己基肉桂醛","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"己基肉桂醛是一种常见的合成香精成分，用于赋予产品花香或甜香气味。对部分敏感人群可能引起皮肤或呼吸道过敏反应。","details":"在护肤和洗护产品中，己基肉桂醛主要作为香料使用，本身不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐或邻苯二甲酸酯，但被欧盟列为需标示的潜在致敏香精之一。低浓度下对大多数人而言较为安全，但敏感肌、湿疹肌或有香精过敏史的人可能出现红斑、瘙痒或接触性皮炎。若产品标明无香或适用于极敏感肌，通常会避免或严格控制此成分用量。","category":"香精成分 / 潜在致敏物"}

山嵛铵甲基硫酸酯__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"山嵛铵甲基硫酸酯","riskLevel":"low","summary":"山嵛铵甲基硫酸酯是一种常用的阳离子表面活性剂和调理剂，常见于护发素和护肤乳中，一般被认为安全温和。它不属于传统刺激性较强的月桂/月硫酸盐类起泡剂。","details":"该成分主要用于柔顺头发、改善梳理性，并在皮肤上起到一定的润滑和柔滑感，一般对大多数肤质和头皮耐受性良好。其名称中带有“硫酸酯”但结构和常说的SLS、SLES不同，不是强力清洁型硫酸盐。极少数敏感或受损皮肤、头皮人群可能出现轻微刺激或不适，建议首次使用时注意观察个体反应。","category":"调理剂 / 阳离子表面活性剂"}

三癸烷__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"三癸烷","riskLevel":"low","summary":"三癸烷是一种合成烃类溶剂与润肤剂，常用于护肤和彩妆中改善涂抹延展性和肤感。通常被认为安全性较高，刺激性较低。","details":"在化妆品中，三癸烷主要用于提供轻盈、不油腻的使用触感，可帮助分散色素并提高产品的流动性与延展性。现有研究和使用历史显示，其致敏性和刺激性较低，且不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、矿物油或硅油等高关注成分。对于极度敏感或屏障受损肌肤，首次使用含有该成分的产品时仍建议先局部试用观察。","category":"溶剂与润肤剂"}

聚季铵盐-47__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"聚季铵盐-47","riskLevel":"low","summary":"聚季铵盐-47是一种阳离子聚合物，常用于护肤和护发产品中作为成膜和调理剂，帮助头发表面顺滑、减少毛躁。一般认为刺激性较低，正常使用下安全性较好。","details":"作为阳离子柔顺剂，聚季铵盐-47能在皮肤和头发表面形成薄膜，改善触感、增加光泽和梳理性，同时不会像硅油那样易造成明显堆积。它不是对羟基苯甲酸酯类、防腐释放甲醛成分，也不是硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或重金属相关物质。极少数敏感肤质或受损头皮在高浓度或长期使用下可能出现轻微刺激或积累感，但总体致敏和毒性风险较低。","category":"调理剂 / 成膜剂"}

四甲基乙酰氢化萘__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"四甲基乙酰氢化萘","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"四甲基乙酰氢化萘是一种常见于香精中的合成芳香成分，用于为护肤和护发产品提供持久木质或麝香调气味。对大多数人来说在低浓度化妆品中使用相对安全，但对敏感肌和易过敏人群可能有一定刺激或致敏风险。","details":"该成分属于合成香料家族，具有较强的持香性，常被添加到面霜、乳液、洗发水及身体护理产品中提升气味体验。部分合成香料在某些人群中可能引起皮肤刺激、发红或接触性皮炎，尤其是已有香精过敏史或屏障受损的肌肤。对于孕妇、哮喘及严重过敏体质人群，一般建议尽量减少含有复杂香精配方产品的长期或大面积使用。","category":"香精/香料成分"}

peg-2m（聚乙二醇-2m）__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"PEG-2M（聚乙二醇-2M）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"PEG-2M是一种聚乙二醇类高分子成分，常用作增稠剂、成膜剂和保湿辅助成分，一般认为对皮肤刺激性较低。","details":"PEG类成分本身通常较为温和，但在工业生产过程中可能存在微量杂质（如1,4-二氧六环等），正规品牌会通过纯化和检测控制其安全性。PEG-2M不属于防腐剂、激素干扰物、硫酸盐表活、邻苯二甲酸酯或释放甲醛类防腐剂，也不是矿物油、硅油或高风险重金属来源。对于皮肤屏障受损或极度敏感人群，仍建议先小面积测试，搭配其他成分整体评估配方温和度。","category":"溶剂与质地调理剂 / 保湿辅助成分"}

油醇（oleyl alcohol）__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"油醇（Oleyl Alcohol）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"油醇是一种来源于植物油或合成的脂肪醇，常用于护肤和护发产品中作为润肤剂和增稠剂。通常刺激性较低，适合大部分肤质使用。","details":"油醇属于高碳链脂肪醇，与会强烈致干的短链酒精（如乙醇、异丙醇）不同，一般不会明显破坏皮肤屏障，反而能帮助柔软角质并减少水分流失。个别人（尤其是极易长痘或毛孔易堵塞人群）在高浓度或配方油脂较重时，可能出现粉刺或闷痘现象。总体来说不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或甲醛释放体，也不是重金属风险来源。","category":"脂肪醇 / 润肤剂"}

甘油__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"甘油","riskLevel":"low","summary":"甘油是一种常见的保湿剂，能够吸水并在皮肤表面形成保湿屏障。通常耐受性良好，刺激性较低。","details":"在护肤和护发产品中，甘油主要用于补水保湿、改善皮肤柔软度，并帮助其他成分更均匀分布。对大多数肤质（包括干性和敏感肌）都较为友好，但极高浓度或在极干环境下可能会有轻微紧绷或干涩感。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、矿物油或硅类，也不是常见的致痘或荷尔蒙干扰成分。","category":"保湿剂/溶剂"}

聚山梨醇酯-60__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"聚山梨醇酯-60","riskLevel":"low","summary":"聚山梨醇酯-60是一种常用的非离子型表面活性剂和乳化剂，用于帮助水油成分均匀混合。一般认为对皮肤刺激较低，广泛用于护肤和护发产品中。","details":"在化妆品中，聚山梨醇酯-60主要用于稳定乳霜和乳液的体系，使产品质地均匀细腻并改善延展性。对大多数肤质来说安全性较高，但极少数敏感肌人群可能出现轻微刺激或致痘问题。它不属于防腐剂、激素干扰物、邻苯二甲酸酯、硫酸盐或释放甲醛类成分，一般被视为相对安全的辅料。","category":"表面活性剂 / 乳化剂"}

鲸蜡硬脂醇__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"鲸蜡硬脂醇","riskLevel":"low","summary":"鲸蜡硬脂醇是一种脂肪醇，常用于护肤和护发产品中作为柔润剂和增稠剂，一般耐受性良好。它通常不会像挥发性酒精那样导致明显干燥。","details":"作为脂肪醇，鲸蜡硬脂醇可以帮助改善配方的质地，使产品更顺滑、易推开，并在皮肤或头发表面形成柔软的保护层，减少水分流失。大多数肤质（包括干皮和敏感肌）通常都能很好耐受，但极少数人可能对脂肪醇类成分有个体敏感，出现轻微刺痒或红斑。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或释放甲醛的成分，也与重金属无关，安全性较高。","category":"脂肪醇 / 柔润剂 / 质地调理剂"}

互叶白千层（茶树）叶水__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"互叶白千层（茶树）叶水","riskLevel":"low","summary":"互叶白千层（茶树）叶水是一种从茶树叶中提取并与水混合的植物性成分，常用于控油、净肤和舒缓问题肌肤。总体安全性较高，但敏感肌和对精油类过敏人群需留意刺激或致敏可能。","details":"茶树叶水通常含有低浓度茶树精油中的活性成分，具有一定的抗菌、控油和清爽作用，适合油性及易长痘肌肤的护理。大多数人使用安全，但高敏感肤质或对茶树精油、萜类成分过敏者可能出现轻微刺痛、发红或过敏反应，建议先局部测试。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、矿物油、硅油或甲醛释放体等高争议类别。","category":"植物提取物/舒缓净肤成分"}

硝酸镁__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"硝酸镁","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"硝酸镁是护肤品中偶见的稳定剂或配方助剂，本身对皮肤刺激性通常较低。主要安全性争议在于它常与释放甲醛的防腐体系（如DMDM 乙内酰脲等）共同使用时的潜在风险。","details":"在化妆品中，硝酸镁常用来稳定配方或与其他成分形成复合体系，一般浓度较低且不易引起大多数人明显刺激。但对极度敏感肌或屏障受损人群，长期或反复接触含有硝酸镁及其相关防腐体系的产品，可能有轻微刺激或致敏风险。需要注意的是，它常出现在含有可能释放甲醛的防腐体系中，若配方中同时含有DMDM 乙内酰脲、咪唑烷基脲等成分，整体配方的安全性需更谨慎评估。","category":"稳定剂/配方助剂"}

酒精__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"酒精","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"在护肤和护发产品中，酒精常用作溶剂、助渗剂和防腐辅料。高浓度或频繁使用可能导致皮肤干燥、刺激或刺痛感，尤其是敏感肌。","details":"这里通常指低分子挥发性酒精（如乙醇、变性乙醇等），可以帮助配方变得清爽、加速成膜和成分渗透，但同时会溶解皮脂膜，使角质层含水量下降。对于油性、痘肌短期使用问题不大，但干性、敏感或屏障受损肌肤长期或高浓度接触，可能引起紧绷、泛红和屏障受损风险。若在成分表靠前且配方又缺乏保湿修护成分，敏感人群需特别谨慎。","category":"溶剂 / 助渗剂 / 潜在刺激成分"}

agua__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Agua","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El agua es el disolvente principal en la mayoría de los productos para el cuidado de la piel y se considera un ingrediente muy seguro.","details":"Se utiliza como base para disolver otros ingredientes, facilitar su aplicación y mejorar la textura del producto. No se asocia con irritación ni con efectos hormonales, tóxicos o acumulativos, por lo que su riesgo en cosmética es muy bajo.","category":"Disolvente / base acuosa"}

glicerina__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Glicerina","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La glicerina es un humectante que ayuda a atraer y retener agua en la piel, mejorando su hidratación. Se considera generalmente segura y bien tolerada.","details":"La glicerina se usa ampliamente en productos para el cuidado de la piel por su capacidad para mantener la barrera cutánea hidratada y flexible. Suele ser bien tolerada incluso por pieles sensibles, aunque en casos muy raros puede causar ligera irritación si se usa en concentraciones muy altas o en piel muy dañada. No está asociada a disruptores hormonales, carcinógenos ni a los ingredientes problemáticos típicos como parabenos, sulfatos agresivos o ftalatos.","category":"Humectante e hidratante"}

estearato de glicerilo__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Estearato de Glicerilo","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El estearato de glicerilo es un emulsionante y emoliente derivado de ácidos grasos que ayuda a mezclar agua y aceite en productos para el cuidado de la piel. Generalmente se considera un ingrediente seguro y bien tolerado.","details":"Este ingrediente se utiliza para mejorar la textura de cremas y lociones, aportando una sensación suave y deslizante sobre la piel. No está asociado a parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído ni metales pesados, y rara vez causa irritación, salvo en personas con piel extremadamente sensible o con alergias específicas a los ácidos grasos. Es adecuado para la mayoría de tipos de piel, incluyendo piel seca y normal.","category":"Emulsionante y emoliente"}

agua de hoja de árbol de té (melaleuca a.analysis: {"name":"Agua de Hoja de Árbol de Té (melaleuca Alternifolia)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Agua destilada de hojas de árbol de té con propiedades antimicrobianas y calmantes para la piel. Se utiliza comúnmente en productos para piel grasa o con tendencia al acné.","details":"Esta agua contiene compuestos derivados del árbol de té que pueden ayudar a reducir la proliferación bacteriana y mejorar la apariencia de imperfecciones leves. En concentraciones típicas de cosméticos se considera segura, aunque en pieles sensibles puede causar irritación o enrojecimiento, por lo que se recomienda prueba de parche. No está relacionada con parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, formaldehído, aceites minerales ni siliconas.","category":"Extracto botánico / ingrediente calmante y antimicrobiano"}

dimeticona__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Dimeticona","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La dimeticona es una silicona utilizada como emoliente y agente acondicionador que forma una película suave sobre la piel y el cabello. Ayuda a mejorar la textura del producto y a reducir la pérdida de agua transepidérmica.","details":"En cosmética, la dimeticona se considera generalmente segura y bien tolerada, incluso en pieles sensibles, ya que es químicamente inerte y tiene baja capacidad irritante. Sin embargo, al crear una barrera oclusiva, en algunas personas con piel muy grasa o propensa al acné puede contribuir a la sensación de poros obstruidos si se combina con otros ingredientes comedogénicos y no se realiza una limpieza adecuada. No está asociada con efectos hormonales ni con toxicidad sistémica relevante a las concentraciones usadas en productos para el cuidado de la piel y el cabello.","category":"Silicona / agente acondicionador y emoliente"}

extracto de fruto de limón (citrus limon.analysis: {"name":"Extracto de Fruto de Limón (citrus Limon)","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Extracto vegetal rico en ácidos de frutas y compuestos antioxidantes que puede aportar luminosidad y efecto exfoliante suave a la piel. Sin embargo, puede resultar irritante o sensibilizante, sobre todo en pieles sensibles o sensibilizadas.","details":"El extracto de fruto de limón contiene ácido cítrico, flavonoides y otros compuestos que pueden ayudar a unificar el tono y ofrecer cierta protección antioxidante. No obstante, los extractos cítricos pueden provocar irritación, enrojecimiento o picor, especialmente en pieles reactivas o dañadas por barrera cutánea alterada. Además, algunos componentes pueden ser fotosensibilizantes, por lo que se recomienda usar protección solar adecuada si se emplea en productos de día.","category":"Extractos botánicos / cítricos"}

pantenol__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Pantenol","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El pantenol es un derivado de la vitamina B5 con propiedades hidratantes y calmantes para la piel. Se considera un ingrediente seguro y bien tolerado en productos de cuidado cutáneo y capilar.","details":"Actúa como humectante, ayudando a atraer y retener agua en la capa córnea, mejorando la suavidad y flexibilidad de la piel y el cabello. Además, puede contribuir a la función barrera y tiene efecto calmante en pieles irritadas o sensibilizadas. Las reacciones adversas son poco frecuentes y suelen limitarse a casos aislados de irritación o alergia de contacto.","category":"Humectante y calmante dérmico"}

alcohol oleílico__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Alcohol Oleílico","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El alcohol oleílico es un alcohol graso de origen generalmente vegetal que actúa como emoliente y espesante en productos para la piel y el cabello. Suele considerarse suave y bien tolerado por la mayoría de los tipos de piel.","details":"Este ingrediente ayuda a suavizar la piel y el cabello, mejorar la textura del producto y estabilizar emulsiones, sin el efecto resecante típico de los alcoholes de cadena corta como el etanol. En pieles muy sensibles o con tendencia acneica puede resultar algo oclusivo si se usa en altas concentraciones, aunque el riesgo de irritación es bajo. No está relacionado con parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos ni liberadores de formaldehído.","category":"Alcohol graso emoliente"}

panetenil etil éter__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Panetenil Etil Éter","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El panetenil etil éter es un derivado lipófilo de la provitamina B5 usado por sus propiedades hidratantes y acondicionadoras de la piel y el cabello. Suele considerarse un ingrediente seguro y bien tolerado en cosmética.","details":"Este compuesto actúa como humectante y acondicionador, ayudando a mejorar la suavidad, flexibilidad y aspecto general de la piel y el cabello. No está relacionado con parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, fragancias ni aceites minerales, y presenta bajo potencial irritante en la mayoría de los tipos de piel. Las reacciones adversas suelen ser raras y se limitan generalmente a personas con hipersensibilidad individual a derivados de la vitamina B5.","category":"Derivado de vitamina / Agente acondicionador"}

tocoferol__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Tocoferol","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El tocoferol es una forma de vitamina E con propiedades antioxidantes que ayuda a proteger la piel del daño causado por los radicales libres. Suele ser bien tolerado por la mayoría de los tipos de piel.","details":"En cosmética, el tocoferol se utiliza para estabilizar las fórmulas y para apoyar la función barrera de la piel, contribuyendo a una mejor hidratación y a reducir el daño oxidativo. En personas muy sensibles o con piel reactiva puede causar irritación leve o enrojecimiento, especialmente a concentraciones altas, pero estos casos son poco frecuentes. No está relacionado con parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos ni otros conservantes liberadores de formaldehído.","category":"Antioxidante / Vitamina E"}

tetrametil acetiloctahidronaftalenos__sk.analysis: {"name":"Tetrametil Acetiloctahidronaftalenos","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Tetrametil acetiloctahidronaftalenos es una molécula sintética utilizada como componente de fragancia con olor ambarado y almizclado. Puede causar irritación o alergias en pieles sensibles o en personas sensibilizadas a las fragancias.","details":"Este compuesto aromático sintético se emplea para aportar y fijar el olor en productos de cuidado de la piel y el cabello. Como otras fragancias, se asocia con riesgo de dermatitis de contacto, especialmente en uso prolongado o en piel comprometida. No se considera un disruptor endocrino principal, pero forma parte de la categoría general de “fragancias”, que suelen agruparse por su potencial alergénico y por la falta de transparencia completa en la formulación.","category":"Fragancia sintética"}

hidróxido de sodio__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Hidróxido de Sodio","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"El hidróxido de sodio es una base fuerte utilizada en cosmética para ajustar el pH de las fórmulas. En bajas concentraciones suele ser seguro, pero en niveles más altos puede ser irritante para la piel y los ojos.","details":"En productos para el cuidado de la piel se usa normalmente en cantidades muy pequeñas solo para equilibrar la acidez, lo que reduce considerablemente el riesgo. Sin embargo, por su naturaleza cáustica, puede causar irritación, enrojecimiento o ardor, especialmente en pieles sensibles o dañadas, si la fórmula no está bien equilibrada o se usa en exceso. No está asociado a disruptores hormonales, metales pesados ni liberadores de formaldehído, pero se considera un ingrediente potencialmente irritante.","category":"Regulador de pH / agente alcalinizante"}

undecano__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Undecano","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El undecano es un hidrocarburo lineal utilizado como emoliente y agente de textura en productos cosméticos. Suele considerarse de bajo potencial irritante y con buena tolerancia cutánea.","details":"En cuidado de la piel se emplea para aportar sensación ligera y sedosa, ayudar a la dispersión de otros ingredientes y mejorar la extensibilidad del producto. No está asociado a efectos como alteración hormonal, liberación de formaldehído ni a problemas de toxicidad sistémica en los usos cosméticos habituales. Puede causar irritación leve en personas muy sensibles a hidrocarburos, pero esto es poco frecuente.","category":"Emoliente y solvente hidrocarbonado"}

fosfato disódico__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Fosfato Disódico","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El fosfato disódico es una sal inorgánica utilizada como regulador de pH y agente tamponador en productos de cuidado de la piel y el cabello. Generalmente se considera un ingrediente de baja preocupación para la mayoría de los usuarios.","details":"En cosmética, el fosfato disódico ayuda a mantener la estabilidad de la fórmula y el pH adecuado, lo que contribuye a la eficacia y seguridad del producto. No está relacionado con parabenos, sulfatos agresivos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, fragancias, aceites minerales ni siliconas. En personas con piel muy sensible o afecciones cutáneas específicas, puede llegar a causar una leve irritación si se usa en fórmulas muy concentradas, pero esto es poco común a las concentraciones habituales.","category":"Regulador de pH y agente tamponador"}

hidroxietilcelulosa__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Hidroxietilcelulosa","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La hidroxietilcelulosa es un polímero derivado de la celulosa que se usa como espesante y estabilizante en productos para el cuidado de la piel y el cabello. Generalmente se considera un ingrediente seguro y bien tolerado.","details":"Este ingrediente ayuda a dar viscosidad a cremas, geles y champús, mejorando la textura y facilitando su aplicación sin aportar grasa. No es sensibilizante común y raramente causa irritación, por lo que se considera adecuado incluso para pieles sensibles. No está asociado con disruptores hormonales, sulfatos, ftalatos ni otros compuestos polémicos habituales en cosmética.","category":"Espesante y agente formador de gel derivado de la celulosa"}

policuaternio-47__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Policuaternio-47","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El policuaternio-47 es un polímero catiónico utilizado como acondicionador y agente antiestático en productos para la piel y el cabello. Suele considerarse de bajo riesgo y bien tolerado por la mayoría de las personas.","details":"Este ingrediente forma una película ligera sobre la superficie de la piel o el cabello, mejorando la suavidad, la manejabilidad y reduciendo el frizz. No está asociado con parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, fragancias, aceites minerales, siliconas ni metales pesados. En pieles muy sensibles o con tendencia a la irritación, un uso excesivo puede contribuir a una ligera acumulación o incomodidad, pero los casos de irritación son poco frecuentes.","category":"Polímero acondicionador / agente antiestático"}

estearamidopropil dimetilamina__skincare.analysis: {"name":"Estearamidopropil Dimetilamina","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La estearamidopropil dimetilamina es un agente acondicionador y emulsionante derivado de ácidos grasos que se usa principalmente en productos capilares y algunos productos faciales. Generalmente se considera de bajo riesgo cuando se usa en concentraciones típicas de cosméticos y se enjuaga del cabello o la piel.","details":"Este ingrediente ayuda a desenredar, suavizar y mejorar la manejabilidad del cabello, funcionando como alternativa a ciertos surfactantes más agresivos. Puede causar irritación leve en personas con piel o cuero cabelludo muy sensibles, sobre todo si se utiliza en productos de alta concentración o de contacto prolongado. No es un paraben, sulfato, ftalato ni liberador de formaldehído, y no está asociado a disrupción endocrina ni a metales pesados.","category":"Acondicionador capilar y agente emulsionante"}

alcohol ceteárico__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Alcohol Ceteárico","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El alcohol ceteárico es un alcohol graso de origen vegetal o sintético que actúa como emulsionante y agente acondicionador de la piel y el cabello. Generalmente se considera un ingrediente seguro y bien tolerado.","details":"A diferencia de los alcoholes secantes (como etanol o alcohol isopropílico), el alcohol ceteárico es un alcohol graso que ayuda a suavizar y aportar textura cremosa a las fórmulas, reduciendo la sensación de sequedad. Es poco probable que cause irritación en la mayoría de las personas, aunque en pieles extremadamente sensibles o con dermatitis atópica podría generar una ligera molestia en casos aislados. No está asociado con alteradores hormonales, liberadores de formaldehído, sulfatos ni ftalatos.","category":"Alcohol graso / emulsionante y acondicionador"}

tridecano__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Tridecano","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El tridecano es un hidrocarburo lineal utilizado en cosmética como solvente ligero y agente de textura. Suele considerarse un ingrediente de bajo riesgo cuando se usa en las concentraciones típicas de productos para la piel y el cabello.","details":"El tridecano ayuda a que la fórmula se extienda mejor sobre la piel y aporta una sensación ligera y no grasa. No es un paraben, sulfato, ftalato, liberador de formaldehído ni fragancia, y tampoco se asocia con aceites minerales pesados, siliconas problemáticas o metales pesados. En pieles muy sensibles u oclusivas, podría contribuir mínimamente a obstruir poros si se combina con otros ingredientes pesados, pero en general se tolera bien.","category":"Solvente y agente de textura"}

fosfato sódico__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Fosfato Sódico","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El fosfato sódico es una sal inorgánica utilizada principalmente como regulador de pH y agente buffer en productos para el cuidado de la piel y el cabello. Generalmente se considera de bajo riesgo a las concentraciones cosméticas habituales.","details":"En cosmética, el fosfato sódico ayuda a estabilizar la fórmula manteniendo el pH dentro de un rango adecuado para la piel, lo que puede mejorar la eficacia y la tolerancia del producto. No está relacionado con parabenos, sulfatos agresivos, ftalatos ni liberadores de formaldehído, y no suele causar irritación, salvo en personas con piel extremadamente sensible o si se usa en concentraciones inusualmente altas. Su principal consideración de seguridad se centra más en la exposición oral excesiva que en el uso tópico, que es muy limitado en el contexto de productos de cuidado personal.","category":"Regulador de pH / agente buffer inorgánico"}
