No es un parabeno ni un liberador de formaldehído, pero sigue siendo un conservante sintético con potencial irritante leve a moderado.","category":"Conservante sintético"}

manteca de karité (butyrospermum parkii).analysis: {"name":"Manteca de Karité (butyrospermum Parkii)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La manteca de karité es un emoliente natural muy nutritivo que ayuda a hidratar y suavizar la piel. Generalmente es bien tolerada, incluso por pieles secas y sensibles.","details":"Es rica en ácidos grasos y compuestos con propiedades antioxidantes y calmantes, por lo que contribuye a reparar la barrera cutánea y reducir la sequedad. El principal riesgo se asocia a posibles reacciones en personas alérgicas a frutos de árbol o a impurezas si la materia prima no está bien refinada, aunque estos casos son poco frecuentes. No pertenece a los grupos de ingredientes de mayor preocupación como parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído ni fragancias sintéticas.","category":"Emoliente y humectante natural"}

extracto de fruto de pomelo (citrus gran.analysis: {"name":"Extracto de Fruto de Pomelo (citrus Grandis)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Extracto vegetal rico en antioxidantes que se utiliza por sus posibles propiedades tonificantes e iluminadoras de la piel. Generalmente se considera seguro, aunque puede causar irritación en pieles muy sensibles o reactivas a los cítricos.","details":"Este extracto aporta compuestos como flavonoides, vitamina C y ácidos de frutas que pueden ayudar a mejorar la textura y el aspecto de la piel. Sin embargo, los extractos cítricos pueden incrementar la sensibilidad cutánea, especialmente en combinación con exposición solar, por lo que se recomienda usar fotoprotección adecuada. No pertenece a los grupos más preocupantes como parabenos, sulfatos fuertes, ftalatos o liberadores de formaldehído.","category":"Extracto botánico / antioxidante"}

extracto de salvia esclarea (salvia scla.analysis: {"name":"Extracto de Salvia Esclarea (salvia Sclarea)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El extracto de salvia esclarea se utiliza en cuidado de la piel por sus posibles propiedades antioxidantes, calmantes y reguladoras del sebo. Generalmente se considera un ingrediente seguro en cosmética.","details":"Este extracto vegetal puede aportar beneficios como ayuda en el equilibrio de pieles mixtas o grasas y apoyo frente al estrés oxidativo gracias a sus compuestos fenólicos. En personas muy sensibles a los aceites esenciales o a las plantas de la familia de las Lamiáceas podría provocar irritación o alergia de contacto, aunque esto es poco frecuente. No está relacionado con parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, fragancias sintéticas, aceites minerales, siliconas, alcoholes secantes ni metales pesados.","category":"Extracto botánico"}

triglicéridos caprílico/cáprico__skincar.analysis: {"name":"Triglicéridos Caprílico/cáprico","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Los triglicéridos caprílico/cáprico son lípidos derivados normalmente del aceite de coco y la glicerina, usados como emoliente ligero. Suelen ser bien tolerados incluso por piel sensible y no se asocian a disruptores hormonales ni a irritación significativa.","details":"Actúan como un aceite estable que suaviza la piel, mejora la textura de las fórmulas y ayuda a disolver otros ingredientes liposolubles sin dejar sensación grasa pesada. No pertenecen a las familias de parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos ni liberadores de formaldehído, y no se consideran comedogénicos en la mayoría de los tipos de piel. En casos poco frecuentes, pieles muy grasas o con acné inflamatorio podrían notar cierta pesadez si se usa en altas concentraciones, pero el riesgo general es bajo.","category":"Emoliente / vehículo lipídico"}

agua purificada__skincare__es.analysis: {"name":"Agua Purificada","riskLevel":"low","summary":"La agua purificada es el disolvente principal en la mayoría de productos para el cuidado de la piel y del cabello y se considera un ingrediente muy seguro. Sirve como base para disolver y distribuir otros componentes de la fórmula.","details":"Al estar filtrada y libre de la mayoría de impurezas, la agua purificada reduce el riesgo de irritación o contaminación microbiana. Su función es aportar un medio acuoso adecuado para que activos, humectantes y otros ingredientes se mezclen y se apliquen de forma uniforme sobre la piel o el cabello. No está asociada con efectos hormonales, toxicidad relevante ni problemas de sensibilidad en la población general.","category":"Disolvente / base acuosa"}

extracto de cáscara de limón (citrus med.analysis: {"name":"Extracto de Cáscara de Limón (citrus Medica Limonum)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El extracto de cáscara de limón se utiliza por sus propiedades antioxidantes, revitalizantes y ligeramente astringentes en productos para el cuidado de la piel. Puede ayudar a iluminar el tono de la piel y aportar un efecto refrescante.","details":"Este extracto natural contiene compuestos como vitamina C, flavonoides y aceites esenciales que pueden proporcionar beneficios antioxidantes y seborreguladores suaves. Sin embargo, los extractos cítricos pueden incrementar la sensibilidad de la piel, especialmente frente al sol, por lo que se recomienda usar protector solar si se utiliza en productos de día. En pieles muy sensibles o reactivas puede causar irritación leve o enrojecimiento, aunque el riesgo general es bajo en formulaciones cosméticas habituales.","category":"Extracto vegetal / ingrediente botánico"}

extracto de yucca schidigera__skincare__.analysis: {"name":"Extracto de Yucca Schidigera","riskLevel":"low","summary":"El extracto de Yucca schidigera es un ingrediente de origen vegetal utilizado principalmente como agente espumante suave y acondicionador de la piel y el cuero cabelludo. Generalmente se considera seguro y bien tolerado en productos de cuidado personal.","details":"Este extracto contiene saponinas naturales que ayudan a limpiar de forma suave sin los efectos agresivos de sulfatos como SLS o SLES. Suele ser adecuado para pieles sensibles, aunque en casos aislados puede causar irritación leve en personas muy reactivas a los extractos vegetales. No está asociado con parabenos, ftalatos, liberadores de formaldehído, aceites minerales, siliconas ni metales pesados, por lo que se percibe como una alternativa más suave en fórmulas de cuidado de la piel y el cabello.","category":"Extracto vegetal / agente limpiador suave"}

extracto de cymbopogon schoenanthus (hie.analysis: {"name":"Extracto de Cymbopogon Schoenanthus (hierba de Limón)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Extracto botánico con propiedades aromáticas y potencialmente antioxidantes utilizado en productos para el cuidado de la piel y el cabello. Generalmente se considera seguro, aunque puede causar irritación en pieles sensibles o alérgicas a los aceites esenciales.","details":"El extracto de hierba de limón aporta fragancia cítrica y puede tener efectos antimicrobianos y tonificantes sobre la piel, por lo que se usa en productos limpiadores y tratamientos. Sin embargo, como otros extractos ricos en compuestos aromáticos (terpenos), puede provocar irritación o sensibilización en personas con piel reactiva, dermatitis o alergias a los aceites esenciales. No pertenece a parabenos, sulfatos, ftalatos ni liberadores de formaldehído, pero funciona en la fórmula de forma similar a un componente de fragancia natural.","category":"Extracto botánico / Fragancia natural"}

纯净水__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"纯净水","riskLevel":"low","summary":"纯净水是护肤品中最基础的溶剂和载体，通常安全性很高。其主要作用是溶解和稀释其他活性成分。","details":"纯净水经过过滤、去离子或反渗透等处理，去除了杂质和重金属，用于提高配方的稳定性和皮肤舒适度。它本身不含防腐剂、香精、硫酸盐、对羟基苯甲酸酯等常见风险物质，也不属于致敏或致痘成分。一般肤质包括敏感肌都可放心使用，与其他成分共同决定产品整体安全性。","category":"溶剂/基质"}

药蜀葵根提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"药蜀葵根提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"药蜀葵根提取物是一种来自植物的舒缓与保湿成分，常用于敏感肌和修护类护肤品。总体安全性较高，致敏和刺激风险较低。","details":"药蜀葵根富含多糖和黏液质，能够在皮肤表面形成柔软保湿薄膜，帮助减缓干燥紧绷和轻微刺激感。它具有一定的舒缓、柔软和辅助修复屏障的作用，适用于干性、敏感性及受刺激皮肤。作为植物提取物，极少数人可能对其产生过敏反应，但在化妆品中通常被认为是温和、安全的成分。","category":"植物提取物/舒缓保湿成分"}

丝兰（尤卡）提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"丝兰（尤卡）提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"丝兰提取物来源于丝兰植物，常用于护肤品中作为起泡剂、清洁和舒缓成分。总体安全性较高，一般皮肤耐受良好。","details":"丝兰提取物含有天然皂苷，可帮助清洁皮肤和头皮，同时具有一定的抗氧化和舒缓作用。极少数敏感肌人群可能出现轻微刺激或过敏反应，但总体风险较低。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐表活、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、矿物油或硅油等高争议成分范畴。","category":"植物提取物 / 功能性辅助成分"}

牛油果树（乳木果）脂__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"牛油果树（乳木果）脂","riskLevel":"low","summary":"牛油果树（乳木果）脂是一种从乳木果果仁中提取的天然植物脂，常用于保湿和修护皮肤屏障。总体来说安全性较高，致敏率低。","details":"它富含脂肪酸和维生素，可帮助滋润干燥肌肤，减少水分流失，对干性、敏感性和受损皮肤较为友好。少数人可能对乳木果成分产生轻微过敏或堵塞毛孔，应在油性痘痘肌上先小面积测试。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体或矿物油等高争议成分。","category":"植物油脂 / 保湿柔润剂"}

迷迭香叶提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"迷迭香叶提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"迷迭香叶提取物是一种天然植物提取物，常用于护肤品中作为抗氧化和舒缓成分。总体安全性较高，一般皮肤类型都能耐受。","details":"迷迭香叶提取物具有一定的抗氧化、抗炎和帮助保护皮肤免受环境损伤的作用，可用于抗老、控油及促进头皮健康的产品中。少数敏感肌或对芳香植物过敏的人可能出现轻微刺激或过敏反应，一般通过低浓度配方和搭配舒缓成分可以降低风险。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、矿物油或硅油等高争议成分类别。","category":"植物提取物／抗氧化成分"}

越橘果实/叶提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"越橘果实/叶提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"越橘果实/叶提取物是一种来源于植物的抗氧化成分，常用于护肤品中帮助对抗自由基并舒缓肌肤。整体安全性较高，一般不会对皮肤造成刺激。","details":"该成分富含花青素、多酚类等天然抗氧化物质，可帮助减轻环境压力对皮肤造成的氧化损伤，并在一定程度上支持皮肤屏障健康。少数敏感肌人群可能对植物提取物产生轻微红痒或不适，但这种情况较少见。配方中通常作为辅助保养成分使用，不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、硅油或矿物油等高争议成分。","category":"植物提取物/抗氧化剂"}

洋甘菊（母菊）花提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"洋甘菊（母菊）花提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"洋甘菊（母菊）花提取物常用于舒缓、镇静和抗氧化护肤配方，一般被认为安全温和。对大多数肤质友好，适用于敏感肌配方。","details":"该成分富含黄酮类等植物活性物，具有抗炎、舒缓泛红和一定抗氧化能力，可帮助减轻皮肤刺激感。少数对菊科植物（如菊花、豚草）过敏的人可能出现接触性皮炎，因此过敏体质人群初次使用时建议先做局部测试。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、矿物油或硅油等高争议成分，在护肤和护发产品中的整体安全性较高。","category":"植物提取物 / 舒缓镇静成分"}

蛇麻（啤酒花）提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"蛇麻（啤酒花）提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"蛇麻（啤酒花）提取物是一种来源于啤酒花花穗的植物提取物，常用于护肤品中以提供舒缓、抗氧化等功效。通常被认为相对温和、安全。","details":"蛇麻提取物含有多酚类和黄酮类成分，可帮助对抗自由基，减轻皮肤受刺激感，并在一定程度上具有舒缓、调理油脂的作用。一般肤质使用耐受性较好，但极少数对菊科或啤酒花等植物过敏的人可能出现轻微红痒或刺激反应。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、矿物油、硅油或释放甲醛类成分，整体安全性较高。","category":"植物提取物 / 舒缓抗氧化成分"}

田马尾草提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"田马尾草提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"田马尾草提取物是一种植物来源成分，常用于护肤品中，具有一定的抗氧化和收敛作用。总体来说在化妆品中的使用安全性较高，致敏率较低。","details":"田马尾草提取物富含二氧化硅、多酚等成分，可帮助皮肤保持一定的紧致感，并为配方提供抗氧化支持。在极少数情况下，植物过敏体质人群可能出现轻微刺激或过敏反应，使用前可先局部试用。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、矿物油或硅油等高争议类别，整体风险较低。","category":"植物提取物"}

醋酸生育酚（维生素e）__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"醋酸生育酚（维生素E）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"醋酸生育酚是维生素E的一种稳定形式，常用于护肤品中作为抗氧化剂，帮助保护皮肤免受自由基损伤。一般耐受性良好，刺激性较低。","details":"它能够帮助减缓配方中油脂成分的氧化变质，同时在皮肤表面起到一定的保湿和修护辅助作用。极少数敏感肌人群可能出现轻微刺激或过敏反应，但总体安全性较高，且不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或释放甲醛类成分。适用于大多数肤质，包括干性和成熟肌肤。","category":"抗氧化剂 / 皮肤调理剂"}

乙基己基甘油__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"乙基己基甘油","riskLevel":"low","summary":"乙基己基甘油是一种常用的保湿剂和辅助防腐剂，能够提升产品的保湿度并增强其他防腐成分的效果。通常皮肤耐受性较好，不属于防腐剂中的激素干扰物或释放甲醛类成分。","details":"在护肤和洗护产品中，乙基己基甘油常与苯氧乙醇等搭配使用，以减少传统防腐剂用量，同时维持较好的抑菌能力。现有研究显示其致敏率较低，仅在极少数敏感或受损皮肤人群中可能出现轻微刺激或过敏反应。总体而言，它不属于防腐剂中争议较大的类别，如对羟基苯甲酸酯类（防腐剂）、邻苯二甲酸酯、释放甲醛防腐剂等，安全性相对较高。","category":"保湿剂 / 辅助防腐剂"}

卡波姆__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"卡波姆","riskLevel":"low","summary":"卡波姆是一种常见的合成高分子增稠剂和凝胶剂，用于调节护肤品的黏度和质地。一般认为对皮肤较为温和，刺激性较低。","details":"卡波姆主要用于面霜、凝胶、乳液中，帮助形成稳定的凝胶结构并改善使用肤感，本身不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐或激素干扰物。对大多数人来说安全性较高，但极少数敏感肌人群可能出现轻微刺激或干燥感，通常与配方的pH和中和剂搭配有关。在常规化妆品使用浓度下，没有明确的致癌、致畸或内分泌干扰证据。","category":"增稠剂/黏度调节剂"}

二甲基硅油__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"二甲基硅油","riskLevel":"low","summary":"二甲基硅油是一种常见硅类成分，用于在皮肤和头发表面形成光滑保护膜，提升柔滑度与防水性。一般认为刺激性较低，适合大多数肤质使用。","details":"在护肤和护发品中，二甲基硅油可减少水分流失，使皮肤触感细腻，并改善头发打结和毛躁问题。少数极度敏感或易长闭口、痘痘的人可能担心其有“封闭感”，在高浓度或多种硅叠加使用时，可能不利于皮肤油脂和代谢物排出。总体来说，其全身毒性和致癌、致激素紊乱等风险证据非常有限，被多数权威机构视为安全成分。","category":"硅油 / 成膜剂"}

库拉索芦荟叶汁__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"库拉索芦荟叶汁","riskLevel":"low","summary":"库拉索芦荟叶汁是一种常见的天然保湿舒缓成分，能帮助缓解皮肤干燥和轻度刺激。一般耐受性较好，安全性较高。","details":"库拉索芦荟叶汁富含多糖、氨基酸和少量维生素，有助于为皮肤补水、镇静晒后不适，并支持皮肤屏障修复。少数敏感或对芦荟过敏的人可能出现发红、刺痒等不适，但不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或甲醛释放体等高风险问题成分，也不涉及矿物油、硅油、重金属等争议物质。","category":"植物提取物/保湿舒缓成分"}

鲸蜡醇__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"鲸蜡醇","riskLevel":"low","summary":"鲸蜡醇是一种常见的脂肪醇，主要用作乳化剂和增稠剂，帮助产品形成细腻稳定的乳霜质地。总体来说对皮肤较为温和，刺激性低。","details":"鲸蜡醇属于“油脂型醇”，不同于乙醇等易挥发的刺激性酒精，一般不会明显削弱皮肤屏障，相反还能提供一定的柔润与滋润感。大多数肤质（包括干性与中性肌）都能良好耐受，但极少数极敏感或易长痘人群可能出现轻微堵塞毛孔或闷痘，需要个体观察。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体或重金属等高争议成分，在护肤和洗护产品中被广泛认为是安全度较高的辅料。","category":"润肤剂 / 乳化剂 / 增稠剂"}

柠檬香茅提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"柠檬香茅提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"柠檬香茅提取物来自柠檬香茅植物，常用于护肤品中作为舒缓、抗氧化和带有清新气味的成分。总体安全性较高，一般皮肤类型都能耐受。","details":"柠檬香茅提取物通常不含对羟基苯甲酸酯类防腐剂、硫酸盐表活剂或邻苯二甲酸酯等高争议成分本身，主要起到植物舒缓、抗氧化以及轻微收敛和控油的作用。由于其具有天然芳香成分，部分敏感肌或对精油类、香料易过敏人群可能出现轻微刺激或过敏反应，建议敏感肌在大面积使用前先做局部测试。整体而言在常规化妆品用量下风险较低。","category":"植物提取物 / 舒缓抗氧化成分"}

辛酸/癸酸甘油三酯__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"辛酸/癸酸甘油三酯","riskLevel":"low","summary":"辛酸/癸酸甘油三酯是一种常用的安全润肤剂和溶剂，来源多为椰子油或棕榈油。对皮肤温和，敏感肌一般也可耐受。","details":"它具有良好的保湿和柔润效果，可帮助软化角质层并提升产品的延展性和肤感。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体、矿物油、硅油或刺激性酒精等争议类别。总体致痘性较低，大多数肤质使用安全，极少数油性或痘痘肌若出现闷痘需个别评估。","category":"润肤剂/溶剂"}

鼠尾草（圣草）提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"鼠尾草（圣草）提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"鼠尾草（圣草）提取物是一种来源于植物的提取物，常用于护肤品中以提供抗氧化和舒缓功效。对大多数肤质来说通常较为温和安全。","details":"该成分主要含有多酚类和精油成分，可帮助抵御自由基、减轻轻微炎症，对油性或混合性皮肤有一定调理皮脂的作用。少数敏感肌或对芳香植物成分过敏的人群可能出现轻微刺激或过敏反应，建议初次使用先做局部皮试。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、甲醛释放体或矿物油等高争议成分。","category":"植物提取物/舒缓与抗氧化成分"}

聚山梨醇酯-20__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"聚山梨醇酯-20","riskLevel":"low","summary":"聚山梨醇酯-20是一种常用的非离子型表面活性剂和乳化剂，能够帮助水油成分充分混合。一般认为其刺激性较低，适合大多数肤质使用。","details":"在护肤和洗护发产品中，聚山梨醇酯-20常用于稳定配方、溶解香精或植物精油，并改善产品的延展性和肤感。整体安全性较好，但在极高浓度或个别人群中可能引起轻微刺激或致痘风险，因此敏感肌或痘痘肌若出现不适可留意使用频率和配伍情况。该成分不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或释放甲醛成分。","category":"乳化剂 / 表面活性剂 / 溶剂"}

积雪草提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"积雪草提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"积雪草提取物是一种常用于护肤品中的植物成分，具有舒缓、修护和抗氧化作用。一般耐受性良好，致敏率较低。","details":"积雪草提取物富含积雪草苷等活性物质，可帮助舒缓皮肤不适，促进皮肤屏障修护，并在一定程度上辅助淡化痘印和细纹。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯、矿物油、硅油或释放甲醛类成分，也不是酒精或重金属来源，因此整体安全性较高。极少数敏感肌人群可能对植物提取物产生轻微刺激或过敏，首次使用可先在局部少量测试。","category":"植物提取物/舒缓修护成分"}

苯氧乙醇__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"苯氧乙醇","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"苯氧乙醇是一种常用防腐剂，用于抑制护肤品和洗护产品中微生物生长。一般浓度下对大多数人相对安全，但可能引起少数人皮肤刺激或过敏。","details":"在欧盟和多数国家，苯氧乙醇在面部和身体护理产品中的推荐上限通常为1%，在此范围内被认为整体安全性尚可。对敏感肌、婴幼儿或屏障受损肌肤，可能出现刺痛、发红或接触性皮炎，长期大量接触也被部分研究讨论其对神经系统和内脏的潜在毒性，但日常合规用量风险较低。选择产品时可关注其排位（靠后通常代表含量较低），极度敏感或孕期人群如有担忧可适度减少使用频次或选择无苯氧乙醇配方。","category":"防腐剂"}

柠檬果皮提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"柠檬果皮提取物","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"柠檬果皮提取物常用于护肤品中，具有抗氧化、收敛和提亮肤色等功效。一般来说对大多数肤质较为安全，但可能增加光敏性并引发刺激。","details":"该成分含有多种植物酸和芳香成分，可帮助调理油脂、辅助去角质，并在配方中起到抗氧化与清新气味的作用。但柠檬类成分含有光敏性物质（如呋喃香豆素），在日晒条件下可能提高晒伤和色沉风险，尤其是敏感肌和易长斑人群需注意。对柑橘类过敏或屏障受损的肌肤，使用高浓度或免洗类产品时可能出现刺痛、泛红或干燥。","category":"植物提取物/香味与功能性活性成分"}

椰子油（cocos nucifera oil）__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"椰子油（Cocos Nucifera Oil）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"椰子油是一种常用的植物油，具有良好的保湿和柔润皮肤的作用。一般被认为安全性较高，但极少数人可能会出现致痘或轻微刺激。","details":"在护肤和护发产品中，椰子油常用作润肤剂和封闭剂，帮助减少水分流失并使皮肤和头发更加柔软顺滑。它不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐、邻苯二甲酸酯或释放甲醛成分，也不是矿物油或硅油类，相对温和。然而，对于极易长痘或毛孔易堵塞的肤质，过高浓度或未配伍使用时，可能增加闭口和粉刺的风险，建议痘痘肌少量或搭配清爽配方使用。","category":"植物油 / 润肤剂"}

甜橙（橙）果皮提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"甜橙（橙）果皮提取物","riskLevel":"low","summary":"甜橙果皮提取物常用于护肤品中，具有抗氧化、提亮肤色和带来清新气味的作用。总体来说安全性较高，但对柑橘类过敏人群可能会有刺激或致敏风险。","details":"甜橙果皮提取物来源于柑橘类果皮，富含类黄酮和维生素等成分，可帮助对抗自由基、改善暗沉，并在配方中兼具一定的天然香味功能。少数情况下，其中的挥发性香料成分（如柠檬烯、芳樟醇等天然存在物）可能引发敏感肌肤轻微刺激或过敏，特别是浓度较高或配方中还有其他致敏成分时。一般日常使用的护肤品中含量较低，未见与防腐剂释放甲醛、邻苯二甲酸酯、矿物油或重金属等高风险问题直接相关。","category":"植物提取物 / 抗氧化与调理成分"}

葡萄柚果提取物__skincare__zh.analysis: {"name":"葡萄柚果提取物","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"葡萄柚果提取物主要来自西柚果实，常用于护肤品中提供抗氧化、提亮肤色等功效。其本身不属于防腐剂、硫酸盐或邻苯二甲酸酯等高争议成分，但柑橘类提取物可能刺激敏感肌。","details":"葡萄柚果提取物富含维生素C、黄酮类和多酚，具有一定抗氧化和清爽控油作用，常用于面霜、精华和洁面产品中，有助于改善暗沉肤色。部分产品中此类柑橘提取物在强光下可能增加光敏风险，对敏感肌或屏障受损人群可能造成刺痛、泛红或过敏。整体安全性较好，但敏感肌、光敏体质或正在使用光敏药物者应先做局部测试并避免日晒暴露。","category":"植物提取物 / 功能性护肤成分"}

奶酪菌种（乳酸菌发酵菌种）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"奶酪菌种（乳酸菌发酵菌种）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"奶酪菌种是用于发酵牛奶制成奶酪的有益微生物，一般被认为是安全的成分。常见于各种奶酪和发酵乳制品中。","details":"奶酪菌种通常包括多种乳酸菌和有时使用的片状菌等，用于发酵和成熟奶酪，赋予奶酪特有的风味和质地。对大多数人而言是安全的，但乳制品过敏或乳糖不耐受人群需要整体注意奶酪这类乳制品的摄入。一般不涉及人工色素、防腐剂或甜味剂等高风险添加剂。","category":"发酵菌种 / 乳制品成分"}

ground coffee beans__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Ground Coffee Beans","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Ground coffee beans are roasted coffee seeds that are milled for brewing and are generally safe for most healthy adults when consumed in moderation. The main health considerations relate to their caffeine content and potential sensitivity in some individuals.","details":"Ground coffee naturally contains caffeine, which can improve alertness and concentration but may cause jitteriness, sleep disturbances, or increased heart rate in sensitive individuals or at high intakes. It also contains beneficial antioxidants and has no artificial additives, colorings, or preservatives. People with certain conditions, such as acid reflux, heart rhythm issues, or pregnancy, may need to limit or avoid coffee based on medical advice.","category":"Beverage ingredient"}

natural vanilla flavor__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Natural Vanilla Flavor","riskLevel":"low","summary":"A flavoring derived mainly from vanilla beans or other natural sources to mimic vanilla taste. It is generally well tolerated by most people.","details":"Natural vanilla flavor is typically produced from vanilla beans or other natural ingredients that contain vanillin and related compounds. It does not usually contain major allergens, but extremely sensitive individuals may want to confirm there are no added carriers like dairy or soy. Compared with artificial vanilla flavor, it is less processed and is considered a low‑risk flavoring agent in normal food amounts.","category":"Natural flavoring"}

unbleached enriched flour__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Unbleached Enriched Flour","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Refined wheat flour that has not been chemically bleached but has vitamins and minerals added back. It contains gluten and has a higher glycemic impact than whole grains.","details":"Unbleached enriched flour is made from wheat with the bran and germ removed, then fortified with nutrients such as iron and B vitamins that are lost during refining. It is a source of gluten and is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity. Because it is a refined carbohydrate, frequent high intake can contribute to blood sugar spikes and may be less beneficial for long‑term metabolic and cardiovascular health compared with whole‑grain flours.","category":"Refined grain containing gluten"}

palm kernel oil__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Palm Kernel Oil","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Palm kernel oil is a plant-derived fat high in saturated fatty acids, which may negatively affect heart health if consumed in large amounts. It contains no major allergens but can contribute to increased calorie and saturated fat intake.","details":"Because palm kernel oil is rich in saturated fat, frequent or high consumption may raise LDL (“bad”) cholesterol and increase cardiovascular risk, especially when overall diet quality is poor. It is often used in processed foods for texture and shelf life, which may indicate a more highly processed product. Environmental and sustainability concerns are also associated with palm-derived oils, though this is not a direct health effect.","category":"Fats and oils"}

nonfat milk powder__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Nonfat Milk Powder","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Nonfat milk powder is dehydrated skim milk and is a source of protein, lactose, and dairy minerals such as calcium. It is a common dairy ingredient and a potential allergen for people with milk allergy or lactose intolerance.","details":"This ingredient provides milk proteins (including casein and whey) and lactose, so it can trigger reactions in individuals with dairy allergy and may cause digestive discomfort in those with lactose intolerance. From a general health perspective, it is considered relatively safe and nutritionally beneficial when tolerated, providing protein and micronutrients. Its main concern is allergenicity rather than issues like additives, artificial sweeteners, or trans fats.","category":"Dairy ingredient"}

palm kernel oil and palm oil__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Palm Kernel Oil And Palm Oil","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Palm kernel oil and palm oil are common edible fats high in saturated fat, which can impact heart health when consumed in excess. They also raise environmental and sustainability concerns.","details":"These oils are frequently used in processed foods because they are inexpensive and stable at high temperatures, but they are relatively high in saturated fats, which may raise LDL (“bad”) cholesterol when eaten in large amounts. They do not inherently contain trans fats unless further hydrogenated, but diets rich in saturated fats are associated with increased cardiovascular risk. In addition, palm cultivation is linked to deforestation and habitat loss, which may concern environmentally conscious consumers.","category":"Edible oils and fats"}

cocoa powder__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Cocoa Powder","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Cocoa powder is a natural product made from roasted cocoa beans and is generally safe for most people. It provides flavor, some fiber, and beneficial plant compounds.","details":"Cocoa powder contains flavonoids and other antioxidants that may offer modest cardiovascular benefits when consumed as part of a balanced diet. The main health considerations are its caffeine and theobromine content, which can be stimulating for sensitive individuals, and potential added sugars when used in sweetened products. Allergic reactions to cocoa are rare but possible in susceptible people.","category":"Natural flavoring / cocoa product"}

cocoa powder processed with alkali__food.analysis: {"name":"Cocoa Powder Processed With Alkali","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Cocoa powder processed with alkali, also called Dutch-processed cocoa, is treated to reduce acidity and create a milder flavor and darker color. It is generally safe but slightly lower in some natural antioxidants compared with natural cocoa.","details":"The alkalization process uses food-grade alkali (such as potassium carbonate) to adjust pH, which improves solubility and changes flavor but does not introduce common allergens or major additives of concern. Some of the native flavonoids are reduced by this processing, so its antioxidant content is typically lower than that of natural cocoa powder. As with regular cocoa, its main considerations are caffeine content and any sugars or fats added elsewhere in the product.","category":"Processed cocoa product / flavoring"}
